jobs.title: Principal Biostatistician

titleByLocale.fr: Biostatisticien principal

jobs.description:
CSL's R&D organization is accelerating innovation to deliver greater impact for patients. With a project-led structure and a focus on collaboration, we’re building a future-ready team that thrives in dynamic biotech ecosystems. Joining CSL now means being part of an agile team committed to developing therapies that make a meaningful difference worldwide.

As Principal Biostatistician you will provide high level expertise in the specialist area of Research Biostatistics. You will support research activities in alignment with the respective Therapeutic Area (TA) Research Strategies. In collaboration with Research teams contribute statistical input towards experimental designs, statistical analyses, interpretation and reporting of research studies, to ensure efficient use of resources as well as robust conclusions and deliveries following regulatory requirements and guidelines. The position plays a key role in executing research strategies, fostering internal and external partnerships, and ensuring delivery of impactful preclinical and translational science packages that support clinical development and business objectives.

Main Responsibilities:

Functional Responsibilities​

• Execute Biostatistics strategies aligned with global therapeutic area (TA) and platform priorities, closely collaborating with across Global Research with key connections with Bioinformatics & AI, Translational Research, Research Therapeutic area leads and research project teams​

• Maintain relevant state-of-the-art knowledge and capabilities through literature review and participation in scientific meetings​

• Oversee statistical design and analysis routines in experiments that translate development strategies into plans to support product development objectives, including process control and validation strategies.​

• Utilise expertise to provide statistical input towards experimental designs, statistical analyses, interpretation and reporting of research studies ​

• Provide statistical advice for contacts with regulatory agencies for pre-clinical R&D topics, e.g., in animal ethics applications​

• Contribute statistical input for regulatory filings for product approvals, for on-market support, and for scientific publications ​

• Coordinate with other data analysis/computational experts (Data Managers, Bioinformaticians, Imaging & AI Analysts, PK/PD/Pharmacometricians, etc.) both in house and externally, to ensure that CSL R&D is current and compliant in statistical methods​

Scientific Innovation & Communication​

• Provide scientific input across R&D programs, including drug discovery, in vitro pharmacology, biomarker development, and OMICS studies..​

• Execute Biostatistical pipelines to enable early decision making across research, drive efficiency and generation of high quality data ​

• Compile scientific reports, regulatory documents, and peer-reviewed publications.​

• Present research findings at internal and external meetings and maintain state-of-the-art knowledge through literature and congress participation.​

External Collaboration & Representation​

• Establish and maintain collaborations with academic institutions, biotech companies, CROs, and other external partners to support execution of the Research Project Portfolio.

• Support patent filings and legal contract negotiations in collaboration with CSL’s legal and IP departments.​

Qualifications and Experience Requirements:

• Postgraduate degree (preferably PhD) in Statistics, Biostatistics, or equivalent experience​

• Minimum of 5 years of experience in pharmaceutical or biotech R&D, or equivalent experience in a relevant academic environment.​

• Proven\ experience in working with scientific teams in a global, cross-functional environment.​

• Excellent communication, analytical, and interpersonal skills..​

• Demonstrated ability to drive innovation, manage complex projects, and translate scientific insights into strategic value.​

• High integrity, organizational skills, a

descriptionByLocale.it:
L'organizzazione R&D di CSL sta accelerando l'innovazione per fornire un maggiore impatto per i pazienti. Con una struttura guidata dal progetto e un focus sulla collaborazione, stiamo costruendo un team pronto per il futuro che prospera negli ecosistemi biotech dinamici. Unirsi a CSL significa ora essere parte di un team agile impegnato a sviluppare terapie che fanno una differenza significativa in tutto il mondo. Come principale biostatistico fornirete competenze di alto livello nell'area specializzata di Ricerca Biostatistica. Sosterrete le attività di ricerca in allineamento con le rispettive aree terapeutiche (TA) Strategie di ricerca. In collaborazione con i team di Ricerca contribuiscono all'apporto statistico verso progetti sperimentali, analisi statistiche, interpretazione e reportistica degli studi di ricerca, al fine di garantire un uso efficiente delle risorse, nonché solide conclusioni e consegne a seguito di requisiti normativi e linee guida. La posizione svolge un ruolo chiave nell'esecuzione di strategie di ricerca, nella promozione di partenariati interni ed esterni, e nella fornitura di pacchetti scientifici preclinici e traduttivi che supportano lo sviluppo clinico e gli obiettivi aziendali. Principali responsabilità: Responsabilità funzionali
• Esegui strategie di biostatistica allineate con l'area terapeutica globale (TA) e le priorità della piattaforma, collaborando strettamente con la Global Research con i collegamenti chiave con Bioinformatics & AI, Ricerca Traduttiva, Area Terapeutica della Ricerca conduce e team di progetto di ricerca
• Mantenere conoscenze e capacità all'avanguardia rilevanti attraverso la revisione della letteratura e la partecipazione a incontri scientifici
• Superare le routine di progettazione e analisi statistica in esperimenti che traducono strategie di sviluppo in piani per sostenere gli obiettivi di sviluppo del prodotto, comprese le strategie di controllo e convalida del processo.
• Utilizzare competenze per fornire input statistici verso progetti sperimentali, analisi statistiche, interpretazione e reportistica degli studi di ricerca
• fornire consulenza statistica per i contatti con le agenzie di regolamentazione per gli argomenti R&D preclinici, ad esempio, nelle applicazioni di etica animale
• Contribuire gli input statistici per gli archivi normativi per le approvazioni dei prodotti, per il supporto sul mercato e per le pubblicazioni scientifiche
• Coordinare con altri esperti di analisi dei dati/computazionali (Data Managers, Bioinformaticians, Imaging & AI Analysts, PK/PD/Pharmacometricians, ecc.) sia in casa che esternamente, per garantire che CSL R&D sia attuale e conforme in metodi statistici Innovazione scientifica e comunicazione
• Fornire input scientifici attraverso i programmi R&D, tra cui la scoperta della droga, la farmacologia in vitro, lo sviluppo di biomarcatori e gli studi OMICS..
• Eseguire condotte biostatistiche per consentire il processo decisionale precoce attraverso la ricerca, l'efficienza e la generazione di dati di alta qualità
• Rapporti scientifici completi, documenti normativi e pubblicazioni peer-reviewed.
• I risultati attuali della ricerca in incontri interni ed esterni e mantengono conoscenze all'avanguardia attraverso la letteratura e la partecipazione al congresso. Collaborazione e rappresentanza esterna
• Stabilire e mantenere collaborazioni con istituzioni accademiche, aziende biotecnologiche, CRO e altri partner esterni per sostenere l'esecuzione del progetto di ricerca Portfolio.
• Sostenere i brevetti e le trattative contrattuali legali in collaborazione con i dipartimenti legali e IP della CSL. Requisiti di esperienza e qualifiche:
• Laurea post-laurea (preferibilmente PhD) in Statistica, Biostatistica, o esperienza equivalente
• Minimo di 5 anni di esperienza in R&D farmaceutico o biotecnologico, o esperienza equivalente in un ambiente accademico rilevante.
• Prova\ esperienza di lavorare con i team scientifici in un ambiente globale e interfunzionale.
• Ottima comunicazione, capacità analitiche e interpersonali..
• Capacità dimostrata di guidare l'innovazione, gestire progetti complessi e tradurre intuizioni scientifiche in valore strategico.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Die F&D-Organisation von CSL beschleunigt Innovationen, um Patienten stärker zu beeinflussen. Mit einer projektgeführten Struktur und einem Schwerpunkt auf Zusammenarbeit bauen wir ein zukunftsfähiges Team, das in dynamischen Biotech-Ökosystemen lebt. Die Teilnahme an CSL bedeutet nun, Teil eines agilen Teams zu sein, das sich für die Entwicklung von Therapien einsetzt, die weltweit einen sinnvollen Unterschied machen. Als Principal Biostatistician bieten Sie hochkarätiges Know-how im Fachgebiet Research Biostatistics. Sie unterstützen Forschungsaktivitäten im Einklang mit dem jeweiligen Therapeutischen Bereich (TA) Forschungsstrategien. In Zusammenarbeit mit Forschungsteams leisten die Forscher einen Beitrag zu experimentellen Designs, statistischen Analysen, Interpretation und Berichterstattung von Forschungsstudien, um einen effizienten Ressourceneinsatz sowie robuste Schlussfolgerungen und Lieferungen nach regulatorischen Anforderungen und Richtlinien zu gewährleisten. Die Position spielt eine zentrale Rolle bei der Durchführung von Forschungsstrategien, der Förderung interner und externer Partnerschaften und der Sicherstellung der Lieferung von schlaggebenden präklinischen und Translationswissenschaftspaketen, die die klinische Entwicklung und die Geschäftsziele unterstützen. Hauptverantwortlichkeiten: Funktionelle Verantwortung
• Execute Biostatistics Strategien, die mit globalen Therapeutikum (TA) und Plattformprioritäten ausgerichtet sind, eng mit Global Research zusammenarbeiten, mit Schlüsselverbindungen zu Bioinformatik & AI, Translational Research, Research Therapeutic Area Leads und Forschungsprojektteams
• Bewahren Sie relevante hochmoderne Kenntnisse und Fähigkeiten durch Literaturüberprüfung und Teilnahme an wissenschaftlichen Sitzungen
• Übersehen Sie statistische Design- und Analyseroutinen in Experimenten, die Entwicklungsstrategien in Pläne zur Unterstützung von Produktentwicklungszielen, einschließlich Prozesskontroll- und Validierungsstrategien, übersetzen.
• Nutzen Sie das Know-how, um statistische Inputs für experimentelle Designs, statistische Analysen, Interpretation und Reporting von Forschungsstudien bereitzustellen
• statistische Beratung für Kontakte mit Regulierungsbehörden für vorklinische FuE-Themen, z.B. in Tierethikanwendungen
• Beitrag der statistischen Eingaben für regulatorische Einreichungen für Produktzulassungen, für die Unterstützung auf dem Markt und für wissenschaftliche Publikationen
• Koordiniert mit anderen Datenanalysen/Komputationsexperten (Data Manager, Bioinformatiker, Imaging & AI Analysten, PK/PD/Pharmacometricians, etc.) sowohl im Haus als auch im Außenbereich, um sicherzustellen, dass CSL R&D in statistischen Methoden aktuell und konform ist Wissenschaftliche Innovation und Kommunikation
• Bereitstellung von wissenschaftlichen Beiträgen über R&D-Programme, einschließlich Drogenentdeckung, in vitro-Apotheke, Biomarkerentwicklung und OMICS-Studien.
• Execute Biostatistical Pipelines, um eine frühzeitige Entscheidungsfindung über Forschung, Antriebseffizienz und Erzeugung hochwertiger Daten zu ermöglichen
• Zusammenfassende wissenschaftliche Berichte, regulatorische Dokumente und peer-reviewed Publikationen.
• Derzeitige Forschungsergebnisse bei internen und externen Treffen und auf dem neuesten Stand der Technik durch Literatur- und Kongressteilnahme. Externe Zusammenarbeit & Vertretung
• Aufbau und Pflege von Kooperationen mit akademischen Institutionen, Biotech-Unternehmen, CROs und anderen externen Partnern zur Unterstützung der Durchführung des Forschungsprojekts Portfolios.
• Unterstützung von Patent- und Vertragsverhandlungen in Zusammenarbeit mit den Rechts- und IP-Abteilungen der CSL. Qualifikations- und Erfahrungsanforderungen:
• Postgraduate-Abschluss (vorzugsweise PhD) in Statistik, Biostatistik oder gleichwertige Erfahrung
• Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der pharmazeutischen oder biotechnologischen FuE oder gleichwertige Erfahrungen in einem relevanten akademischen Umfeld.
• Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit wissenschaftlichen Teams in einer globalen, funktionsübergreifenden Umgebung.
• Ausgezeichnete Kommunikation, analytische und zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten..
• Demonstrierte Fähigkeit, Innovationen voranzutreiben, komplexe Projekte zu verwalten und wissenschaftliche Erkenntnisse in strategischen Wert zu übersetzen.
• Hohe Integrität, organisatorische Fähigkeiten, a
descriptionByLocale.fr:
L'organisme de R-D de CSL accélère l'innovation pour accroître l'impact sur les patients. Avec une structure dirigée par le projet et un accent sur la collaboration, nous construisons une équipe prête à l'avenir qui prospère dans les écosystèmes biotechnologiques dynamiques. Rejoindre CSL signifie maintenant faire partie d'une équipe agile engagée à développer des thérapies qui font une différence significative dans le monde entier. En tant que biostatisticien principal, vous fournirez une expertise de haut niveau dans le domaine spécialisé de la biostatistique de recherche. Vous soutiendrez les activités de recherche conformément aux stratégies de recherche respectives du domaine thérapeutique. En collaboration avec les équipes de recherche, contribuer à la conception expérimentale, à l'analyse statistique, à l'interprétation et à l'établissement de rapports sur les études de recherche, afin d'assurer une utilisation efficace des ressources ainsi que des conclusions et des livraisons solides conformément aux exigences réglementaires et aux lignes directrices. Le poste joue un rôle clé dans l'exécution de stratégies de recherche, la promotion de partenariats internes et externes et la prestation de trousses scientifiques précliniques et translationnelles qui appuient le développement clinique et les objectifs opérationnels. Principales responsabilités : Responsabilités fonctionnelles
• Exécuter des stratégies de biostatistique alignées sur les priorités du domaine thérapeutique mondial (TA) et de la plate-forme, en collaborant étroitement avec l'ensemble de la recherche mondiale avec des liens clés avec la bioinformatique et l'IA, la recherche translationnelle, la recherche Les chefs de file du domaine thérapeutique et les équipes de projet de recherche
• Maintenir les connaissances et les capacités pertinentes à la fine pointe de la technologie grâce à l'examen de la documentation et à la participation à des réunions scientifiques
• Superviser les routines de conception et d'analyse statistiques dans les expériences qui traduisent les stratégies de développement en plans d'appui aux objectifs de développement des produits, y compris les stratégies de contrôle des processus et de validation.
• Utiliser l'expertise pour apporter une contribution statistique à la conception expérimentale, aux analyses statistiques, à l'interprétation et à la communication d'études de recherche
• Fournir des conseils statistiques pour les contacts avec les organismes de réglementation dans les domaines de la R-D préclinique, par exemple dans les applications en éthique animale
• Apporter des données statistiques pour les dépôts réglementaires pour l'approbation des produits, pour le soutien sur le marché et pour les publications scientifiques
• Coordonner avec d'autres experts en analyse de données/computation (gestionnaires de données, bioinformaticiens, analystes de l'imagerie et de l'intelligence artificielle, PK/PD/Pharmacometiciens, etc.) tant à l'interne qu'à l'externe, pour s'assurer que la R & D CSL est à jour et conforme aux méthodes statistiques Innovation scientifique et communication
• Fournir des données scientifiques dans le cadre des programmes de R-D, y compris la découverte de médicaments, la pharmacologie in vitro, le développement de biomarqueurs et les études OMICS.
• Exécuter des pipelines biostatistiques pour permettre une prise de décision rapide dans la recherche, stimuler l'efficacité et la production de données de haute qualité
• Compiler des rapports scientifiques, des documents réglementaires et des publications évaluées par les pairs.
• Présenter les résultats de la recherche lors de réunions internes et externes et maintenir des connaissances de pointe grâce à la littérature et à la participation aux congrès. Collaboration et représentation externes
• Établir et maintenir des collaborations avec des établissements universitaires, des entreprises de biotechnologie, des CRO et d'autres partenaires externes pour soutenir l'exécution du portefeuille de projets de recherche.
• Soutenir les dépôts de brevets et les négociations de contrats juridiques en collaboration avec les services juridiques et de propriété intellectuelle de la CSL. Qualifications et exigences en matière d'expérience :
• Diplôme de troisième cycle (de préférence doctorat) en statistique, biostatistique ou expérience équivalente
• Au moins 5 années d'expérience en R-D pharmaceutique ou biotechnologique, ou une expérience équivalente dans un environnement académique pertinent.
• Expérience éprouvée de travail avec des équipes scientifiques dans un environnement global et interfonctionnel.
• Excellentes compétences en communication, en analyse et en relations interpersonnelles.
• Capacité démontrée de stimuler l'innovation, de gérer des projets complexes et de traduire les connaissances scientifiques en valeur stratégique.
• Haute intégrité, compétences organisationnelles

jobs.title: Global Safety Lead - Formulation Safety

titleByLocale.it: Responsabile Globale della Sicurezza - Sicurezza delle Formulazioni
titleByLocale.fr: Responsable mondial de la sécurité - Sécurité des formulations

jobs.description:
Located within CSLB’s GSPV department, the Director, Global Safety Lead, Formulation Safety provide expertise on all aspects of –clinical safety throughout the entire lifecycle of a product with special emphasis on ongoing evaluation of safety information during clinical development and post approval. (S)He will apply sound medical judgment for analysis and interpretation of complex clinical safety data for signal detection and initiation of safety risk management activities including safety specification, PV planning and risk minimization/mitigation. Integrate safety risk management activities of the product into their medical, business, and regulatory context.

The role serves as the safety representative in the cross-functional development teams and post-marketing product teams. It is responsible for setting safety strategy for these global projects. Strong product knowledge is needed for success in the role.

The role ensures that the medical and process standards delivered in CSLB are in alignment with the following safety objectives expected of manufacturers by internal and external stakeholders including regulators, governmental agencies, payors, physicians, patients and the general public:

• Complying with legal requirements and company standards of the PV (Pharmacovigilance) tasks and responsibilities.

• Preventing harm from adverse reactions in humans arising from the use of authorized medicinal products within or outside the terms of the market authorization or from occupational exposure.

• Promoting the safe and effective use of medicinal products in particular through providing timely information about the safety of medicinal products to patients, healthcare professionals and the public.

• Contributing to the protection of patients and public health.

Responsibilities and Accountabilities

• Safety Surveillance and Risk Management: Oversees safety management teams ensuring a thorough and consistent approach to the review of safety data emerging from clinical trials and from the post-marketing environment. Oversees the safety signal detection and medical signal evaluation process. Oversees analysis of aggregate safety data and the production of key company documents such as DSURs (Development Safety Update Reports), PSURs (Periodic Safety Update Reports) and risk management plans relating to the safety of medicinal products, which are subject to regulatory review and discussion.

• Quality Management: Ensures timely production of aggregate reports and answers to queries from Health Authorities according to consistent quality standards.

• Regulatory Agency Requests: Responsible for timely and concise responses to Regulatory Agency requests relating to patient safety.

• Inspections: Ensures regulatory agency inspection findings and internal audit findings relating to products of responsibility are addressed and resultant Corrective Action Plans (CAPA plans) are implemented efficiently and effectively in the function.

• Clinical Safety Development of the CSLB portfolio: Oversees all processes that lead to the production of safety sections and content of relevant clinical trial documents including protocols, investigator brochures, informed consent forms, clinical study reports. Oversees development of core safety information for new products. Sets the strategy, reviews and approves key filing documents including Integrated Summary of Safety (ISS), Summary of Clinical safety (SCS), and risk management plans (RMPs). Provides major contributions to current and potential safety issues, being proactive in addressing safety issues and setting up any additional systems to mitigate risk in CSLB’s studies. Gives guidance on various medical, product-related and process-related matters in a complex medical and scientific environment including many interface departments and functions.

• Clinical Safety Representation: Chairs the Safety Management Team (SMT). Represents GSPV in relevant cross functional teams.

Qualificati

Strong product knowledge is needed for success in the role. The role ensures that the medical and process standards delivered in CSLB are in alignment with the following safety objectives expected of manufacturers by internal and external stakeholders including regulators, governmental agencies, payors, physicians, patients and the general public:
• Complying with legal requirements and company standards of the PV (Pharmacovigilance) tasks and responsibilities.
• Preventing harm from adverse reactions in humans arising from the use of authorized medicinal products within or outside the terms of the market authorization or from occupational exposure.
• Promoting the safe and effective use of medicinal products in particular through providing timely information about the safety of medicinal products to patients, healthcare professionals and the public.
• Contributing to the protection of patients and public health. Responsibilities and Accountabilities
• Safety Surveillance and Risk Management: Oversees safety management teams ensuring a thorough and consistent approach to the review of safety data emerging from clinical trials and from the post-marketing environment. Oversees the safety signal detection and medical signal evaluation process. Oversees analysis of aggregate safety data and the production of key company documents such as DSURs (Development Safety Update Reports), PSURs (Periodic Safety Update Reports) and risk management plans relating to the safety of medicinal products, which are subject to regulatory review and discussion.
• Quality Management: Ensures timely production of aggregate reports and answers to queries from Health Authorities according to consistent quality standards.
• Regulatory Agency Requests: Responsible for timely and concise responses to Regulatory Agency requests relating to patient safety.
• Inspections: Ensures regulatory agency inspection findings and internal audit findings relating to products of responsibility are addressed and resultant Corrective Action Plans (CAPA plans) are implemented efficiently and effectively in the function.
• Clinical Safety Development of the CSLB portfolio: Oversees all processes that lead to the production of safety sections and content of relevant clinical trial documents including protocols, investigator brochures, informed consent forms, clinical study reports. Oversees development of core safety information for new products. Sets the strategy, reviews and approves key filing documents including Integrated Summary of Safety (ISS), Summary of Clinical safety (SCS), and risk management plans (RMPs). Provides major contributions to current and potential safety issues, being proactive in addressing safety issues and setting up any additional systems to mitigate risk in CSLB’s studies. Gives guidance on various medical, product-related and process-related matters in a complex medical and scientific environment including many interface departments and functions.
• Clinical Safety Representation: Chairs the Safety Management Team (SMT). Represents GSPV in relevant cross functional teams. Qualificati

jobs.description:
CSL's R&D organization is accelerating innovation to deliver greater impact for patients. With a project-led structure and a focus on collaboration, we’re building a future-ready team that thrives in dynamic biotech ecosystems. Joining CSL now means being part of an agile team committed to developing therapies that make a meaningful difference worldwide.

Could you be our next Senior Director Search & Evaluation Late TA Lead, Immunology? The job is in our Waltham MA, King of Prussia PA, Glattburg Switzerland or Maidenhead UK Office. This is a hybrid position and is onsite three days a week.

Position Description Summary ​

Senior Directors of Search & Evaluation to lead strategic sourcing and evaluation of later-stage external Hematology therapeutic area. You will focus on opportunities from Phase 2 through marketed drugs, requiring deep clinical expertise, strong engagement with external Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) and clinical investigators, and a keen understanding of evolving standards of care. The role is critical to shaping our portfolio through high-impact partnerships and transactions. ​

Main Responsibilities & Accountabilities ​

• Serve as the senior S&E leader within the TALT, influencing therapeutic strategy and integrating late-stage external innovation priorities into portfolio planning. ​

• Lead proactive sourcing efforts for Phase 2 to marketed assets, identifying opportunities that align with TA strategy and unmet medical needs. ​

• Co-lead internal meetings (with Early Search Lead) focused on evaluating and prioritizing New Product Opportunities (NPOs) within each CSL’s therapeutic areas. NPO meetings are strategic checkpoints where cross-functional teams review potential assets identified by Search and decide whether to advance them for further due diligence and deal negotiations ​

• Engage extensively with external KOLs, clinical investigators, and networks to validate asset potential, understand trial designs & clinical endpoints, and anticipate competitive dynamics. ​

• Maintain deep awareness of changing standards of care and competitive landscapes to inform sourcing priorities and deal strategy. ​

• Drive cross-functional due diligence for late-stage assets, coordinating clinical, regulatory, commercial, and market access assessments to support governance decisions. ​

• Partner closely with BD and Regional Ecosystem Leads to advance high-priority opportunities through negotiation and deal close, ensuring seamless handoff and execution ​

• Represent the TA externally, leading sourcing activities at specialized conferences and building relationships with pharma, biotech, and clinical communities. ​

Qualifications & Experience Requirements ​

• 15+ years in biopharma with significant experience in clinical development, external innovation, or business development. ​

• Advanced degree required (MD, PhD, or equivalent). ​

• Deep clinical expertise in Immunology, Hematology, or Cardiovascular/Renal therapeutic areas. ​

• Proven track record of sourcing and closing late-stage deals and engaging with KOLs and clinical networks. ​

• Strong understanding of regulatory pathways, market access, and competitive standards of care. ​

The expected base salary range for this position at hiring is $263,000 - $328,000. Please note this salary range reflects the minimum and maximum base pay that CSL expects to pay for this position at the listed for Waltham MA at the time of this posting. Individual base salary for a successful candidate is determined by qualifications, skill level, experience, competencies and other relevant factors. In addition to base salary, total compensation for this role may also include incentive compensation and equity.

• Rappresentare l'AT all'esterno, guidando attività di sourcing in conferenze specializzate e costruendo rapporti con comunità farmaceutiche, biotecnologiche e cliniche. ​ Qualifiche e requisiti di esperienza ​

• Comprovata esperienza nell'approvvigionamento e nella chiusura di accordi in fase avanzata e nel coinvolgimento di KOL e reti cliniche. ​

descriptionByLocale.de:
Die Forschungs- und Entwicklungsorganisation von CSL beschleunigt Innovationen, um eine größere Wirkung für Patienten zu erzielen. Mit einer projektorientierten Struktur und einem Fokus auf Zusammenarbeit bauen wir ein zukunftsfähiges Team auf, das in dynamischen Biotech-Ökosystemen erfolgreich ist. Jetzt bei CSL einzusteigen bedeutet, Teil eines agilen Teams zu sein, das sich für die Entwicklung von Therapien einsetzt, die weltweit einen bedeutenden Unterschied machen. Könnten Sie unser nächster Senior Director Search & Evaluation Late TA Lead, Immunology sein? Die Stelle findet in unserem Büro in Waltham MA, King of Prussia PA, Glattburg Schweiz oder Maidenhead UK statt. Es handelt sich um eine Hybridposition, die an drei Tagen in der Woche vor Ort ist. Zusammenfassung der Positionsbeschreibung ​ Senior Directors of Search & Evaluation leiten die strategische Beschaffung und Bewertung des späteren externen Therapiebereichs Hämatologie. Sie konzentrieren sich auf Chancen von Phase 2 bis hin zu vermarkteten Arzneimitteln. Dies erfordert umfassende klinische Fachkenntnisse, eine starke Zusammenarbeit mit externen Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) und klinischen Prüfärzten sowie ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für die sich entwickelnden Pflegestandards. Die Rolle ist entscheidend für die Gestaltung unseres Portfolios durch wirkungsvolle Partnerschaften und Transaktionen. ​ Hauptaufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten ​
• Fungieren Sie als leitender S&E-Leiter innerhalb des TALT, beeinflussen Sie die Therapiestrategie und integrieren Sie externe Innovationsprioritäten in der Spätphase in die Portfolioplanung. ​
• Führen Sie proaktive Beschaffungsbemühungen für Phase 2 zu vermarkteten Vermögenswerten durch und identifizieren Sie Möglichkeiten, die mit der TA-Strategie und ungedeckten medizinischen Bedürfnissen übereinstimmen. ​
• Co-Leitung interner Meetings (mit Early Search Lead), die sich auf die Bewertung und Priorisierung von New Product Opportunities (NPOs) innerhalb der Therapiebereiche jedes CSL konzentrieren. NPO-Meetings sind strategische Kontrollpunkte, an denen funktionsübergreifende Teams potenzielle Assets überprüfen, die von Search identifiziert wurden, und entscheiden, ob sie für weitere Due-Diligence-Prüfungen und Vertragsverhandlungen weiterverwendet werden sollen.
• Arbeiten Sie intensiv mit externen KOLs, klinischen Prüfärzten und Netzwerken zusammen, um das Asset-Potenzial zu validieren, Studiendesigns und klinische Endpunkte zu verstehen und die Wettbewerbsdynamik zu antizipieren. ​
• Behalten Sie ein tiefes Bewusstsein für sich ändernde Pflegestandards und Wettbewerbslandschaften bei, um Beschaffungsprioritäten und Geschäftsstrategien zu informieren. ​
• Fördern Sie die funktionsübergreifende Due Diligence für Vermögenswerte in der Spätphase und koordinieren Sie klinische, regulatorische, kommerzielle und Marktzugangsbewertungen, um Governance-Entscheidungen zu unterstützen. ​
• Arbeiten Sie eng mit BD und regionalen Ökosystem-Leads zusammen, um durch Verhandlungen und Geschäftsabschlüsse Chancen mit hoher Priorität voranzutreiben und eine reibungslose Übergabe und Ausführung sicherzustellen. ​
• Repräsentieren Sie den TA nach außen, leiten Sie Beschaffungsaktivitäten auf Fachkonferenzen und bauen Sie Beziehungen zu Pharma-, Biotech- und klinischen Communities auf. ​ Qualifikations- und Erfahrungsanforderungen ​
• 15+ Jahre in der Biopharmabranche mit umfangreicher Erfahrung in der klinischen Entwicklung, externen Innovation oder Geschäftsentwicklung. ​
• Fortgeschrittener Abschluss erforderlich (MD, PhD oder gleichwertig). ​
• Umfassendes klinisches Fachwissen in den Bereichen Immunologie, Hämatologie oder Herz-Kreislauf-/Nierentherapie. ​
• Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz bei der Beschaffung und dem Abschluss von Spätphasengeschäften sowie der Zusammenarbeit mit KOLs und klinischen Netzwerken. ​
• Ausgeprägtes Verständnis der Regulierungswege, des Marktzugangs und wettbewerbsfähiger Pflegestandards. Die erwartete Grundgehaltsspanne für diese Position liegt bei Einstellung zwischen 263.000 und 328.000 US-Dollar. Bitte beachten Sie, dass diese Gehaltsspanne das minimale und maximale Grundgehalt widerspiegelt, das CSL zum Zeitpunkt dieser Veröffentlichung für diese Position bei Waltham MA zu zahlen erwartet. Das individuelle Grundgehalt eines erfolgreichen Kandidaten wird durch Qualifikationen, Fähigkeitsniveau, Erfahrung, Kompetenzen und andere relevante Faktoren bestimmt. Die Gesamtvergütung für diese Position kann neben dem Grundgehalt auch Anreizvergütung und Eigenkapital umfassen. #LI-HYBRID Über CSL Behring CSL Behring ist ein weltweit führendes Unternehmen im Bereich Biotherapeutika, angetrieben von unserem Versprechen, Leben zu retten. Wir konzentrieren uns darauf, den Bedürfnissen der Patienten durch den Einsatz neuester Technologien gerecht zu werden, und entdecken, entwickeln und liefern innovative Therapien für Menschen mit Erkrankungen

Rejoindre CSL, c’est désormais faire partie d’une équipe agile engagée à développer des thérapies qui font une différence significative dans le monde entier. Vous vous concentrerez sur les opportunités de la phase 2 jusqu'aux médicaments commercialisés, nécessitant une expertise clinique approfondie, un engagement fort avec les principaux leaders d'opinion (KOL) externes et les enquêteurs cliniques, ainsi qu'une compréhension approfondie de l'évolution des normes de soins. jobs.description:
The Director Non-Clinical Due Diligence & External Evaluations provides scientific leadership for nonclinical due diligence supporting CSL’s in‑licensing, acquisitions, and strategic collaborations. The role ensures integrated, objective, and decision‑relevant evaluations of nonclinical pharmacology, PK/QSP, and toxicology data to identify development risks, data gaps, and mitigation strategies and to inform portfolio decisions.
The incumbent will further act as nonclinical representative for selected Research programs and support oversight of nonclinical strategies and programs across all Therapeutic Areas.

The role reports to the Executive Director, Head of Nonclinical Development.

Responsibilities and accountabilities

• Leads operational execution of nonclinical due diligence for assigned opportunities.

• Acts as hands‑on scientific integrator, translating expert input into clear risk narratives.

• Trusted subject‑matter lead for nonclinical DD on individual deals.

jobs.description:
Global Product Leader
Some roles exist to manage processes. This one exists to make consequential decisions about medicines that matter to patients with serious diseases — and to ensure those decisions are made well, at pace, and with the full weight of evidence behind them.
CSL Behring is seeking a Global Product Leader (GPL) to take end-to-end ownership of a late-stage development asset, from late research transition through development, commercialization, and lifecycle management. The accountability is real: for strategy, for delivery, and for the value the asset creates across its lifetime.

The Role
As GPL, you will sit on the Therapeutic Area Leadership Team and represent the asset at CSL's most senior governance forums. You will lead a global, cross-functional Product Strategy Team — bringing together clinical, regulatory, commercial, manufacturing, and scientific expertise into a coherent, executable plan. You will own the asset strategy, drive it through governance with clear, well-framed recommendations, and ensure the organization moves decisively when decisions are needed.
The scope is broad. You will integrate competitive intelligence, payer dynamics, patient insights, and evolving clinical data into strategic trade-offs. You will lead lifecycle value creation — label expansions, new indications, geographic reach. You will represent CSL externally, including in due diligence and partnership contexts. Your thinking will be tested by people who know the science, the market, and the economics — and it needs to hold up.
Leadership here means influence rather than line authority: building alignment across functions and sustaining it through organizational complexity, competing priorities, and the inevitable turbulence of long development programs.

What You'll Be Responsible For
You will own the Product Strategy Plan and keep it current as data and conditions evolve — balancing honest advocacy for the asset with the objectivity to adjust when the evidence calls for it. You will prepare governance bodies to make good decisions by giving them well-structured options, clear trade-offs, and a recommendation you're willing to defend. You will anticipate risks and surface them early, rather than letting surprises reach the wrong moment.
You will shape a team culture where problems are raised before they escalate, accountability is shared, and the work moves with both strategic clarity and execution discipline. You will contribute to building the next generation of product leaders at CSL and to the continued development of the GPL function itself.

What We're Looking For
You likely have 12 or more years in pharmaceutical or biopharmaceutical development, with experience that spans the value chain — from late research or early clinical stages through to commercialization or market access. You have owned an asset in a meaningful sense: responsible for its direction and outcomes, not just its coordination.
You can hold a position under pressure and revise it when the data warrant. You can read a complex situation — scientific, organizational, commercial — and turn it into a clear narrative and a plan that people will follow.
An advanced degree is required; a PhD, MD, PharmD, or MBA is preferred. Therapeutic area expertise in CSL Behring's portfolio is an advantage, though not a prerequisite for the right candidate.

Working Arrangements
Hybrid, 3 days a week onsite, plus business travel

CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients’ needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas. titleByLocale.fr: Ingénieur principal principal, Facteurs humains

jobs.description:
This role is a position in the Drug Delivery Systems & Packaging (DDSP) department within CSL Technical Operations. The ideal candidate has a solid track record in the development of drug delivery devices, from concept development through commercialization and product maintenance. This role requires experience in leading user interface development and a passion for making the right product that meets the needs of the patients.
The ideal candidate will understand how CSL drug delivery devices operate and the interface to users and will translate this into design of the user interface and instructional materials.
CSL is looking to transform our Human Factors Engineering team from mainly executing formative and summative studies to more front-end development work. This includes evaluation and selection of commercially available device and primary packaging components, as well as user interface development to meet user needs.

Responsibilities

• Act as Lead Human Factors Engineer

• Plan and execute Human Factors Engineering activities in drug delivery device projects, including development of secondary packaging and Instructions for Use

• Set and drive best practices within DDS&P for Human Factors Engineering

• Support standardization of approaches for Task Analysis, Use Risk Assessment, and other key deliverables

• Lead HF oversight of secondary packaging development

• Partner with project leads and the cross-functional development team on planning and execution of projects

• Lead development of selection criteria and evaluation of the user interface for new products

• Collect, maintain, and utilize data on user capabilities and known use problems with combination products

• Contribute to the development of Company Core Data Sheets (CCDS)

• Plan and execute Formative and Summative evaluations, including selection and oversight of CROs

• Leverage existing data to support regulatory submissions, e.g., comparative analysis

• Develop dossier submissions for HF content, including HFE/UE Report, and responses to regulatory agency questions

• Monitor industry trends, standards, and regulatory guidance

Qualifications

• Excellent communication skills and a track record working in a matrix environment

• Ability to influence and promote a culture of continuous improvement

• Subject Matter Expertise on:

• IEC 62366 family of standards and related regulatory guidance

• User Capabilities – anthropometric basis

• Use Risk Assessments

• Proven track record of:

• Evaluation of user interfaces for drug delivery devices

• Development of instructional materials for product labelling and artwork

• Relevant academic qualification in an appropriate field, e.g., Ergonomics, Psychology or a suitable Science or Engineering degree

• At least 8 years of related experience in the pharmaceutical or medical device industry

• Ability to travel internationally up to 20%

About CSL Behring
CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients’ needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas. We use three strategic scientific platforms of plasma fractionation, recombinant protein technology, and cell and gene therapy to support continued innovation and continually refine ways in which products can address unmet medical needs and help patients lead full lives.

CSL Behring operates one of the world’s largest plasma collection networks, CSL Plasma. Our parent company, CSL, headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, employs 32,000 people, and delivers its lifesaving therapies to people in more than 100 countries.
To learn more about CSL, CSL Behring, CSL Seqirus and CSL Vifor visit https://www.csl.com/ and CSL Plasma at https://www.cslplasma.com/ .

Our Benefits
For more information on CSL benefits visit

jobs.description:
Role Overview:
The Senior Director of Market Access for Inline Assets will be responsible for shaping and implementing market access strategies for CSL Behring inline assets. This role is accountable for maximizing the asset total life cycle value throughout product life cycle. It requires strong expertise in obtaining, sustaining, and optimizing product pricing & reimbursement, and a comprehensive understanding of the payer environment in key international markets.

Key Responsibilities:
• Lead the Market Access inline team in one Therapeutic Areas (TAs). Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing global market access inline team, fostering a culture of collaboration, innovation, inclusion, and accountability.
• Serve as a key member of the global Market Access Leadership Team (MALT), contributing to the development and execution of functional strategy, operations, and capability building.
• Accountable for Market Access deliverables during the inline phase, continuously refining and improving standards for these deliverables.
• Collaborate with Medical Affairs, Marketing, and other partner functions to influence brand strategy and execution, ensuring proper integration of market access considerations.
• Keep abreast with payer policies and regulations, economic data within the assigned TA in key international markets. Identify market access opportunities and risks, capture opportunities, mitigate risks through proactive planning, scenario analysis, and stakeholder engagement.
• Deliver and periodically update the Global Value Dossier as a foundational document for affiliate Pricing & Reimbursement (P&R) and Health Technology Assessment (HTA) submissions and resubmissions.
• Provide guidance and support to country teams in P&R and HTA submissions, negotiations, and authority responses, ensuring alignment with global strategies.
• Optimize payer value propositions (PVPs) and health economic models to effectively communicate the clinical and economic value of inline assets to payers and other key stakeholders.
• Continuously drive the development of lifecycle payer evidence and optimize pricing strategies to maintain and enhance P&R throughout the product lifecycle.
• Provide systematic market access insights for forecasting and long-range planning, including analysis of key payer policy changes, risk assessments, and opportunity identification.
• Represent CSL at global trade associations, participating in access-related committees and working groups to influence industry standards and practices.

Qualifications:
• At least 12 years of experience in market access, with significant exposure to diverse healthcare systems in the international markets.
• Proven track record of leading and developing high-performing teams in a global, crossfunctional environment. A role model of collaboration, innovation, inclusion, and accountability.
• Proven track record in obtaining, sustaining, and optimizing pricing, reimbursement, and patient access across diverse healthcare systems in international markets.
• Extensive knowledge of global healthcare systems, payer landscapes, and the interplay between market access and international markets.
• Proven ability to deliver superior performance across diverse healthcare systems in the international markets.
• An advanced degree in Health Economics, Public Health, or a related field is required.

About CSL Vifor
CSL Vifor is a global partner of choice for pharmaceuticals and innovative, leading therapies in iron deficiency and nephrology. We specialize in strategic global partnering, in-licensing and developing, manufacturing and marketing pharmaceutical products for precision healthcare, aiming to help patients around the world lead better, healthier lives. Headquartered in St. Gallen, Switzerland, CSL Vifor also includes the joint company Vifor Fresenius Medical Care Renal Pharma (with Fresenius Medical Care). The parent company, CSL, headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, employs 32,000 people

descriptionByLocale.en:
Role Overview:
The Senior Director of Market Access for Inline Assets will be responsible for shaping and implementing market access strategies for CSL Behring inline assets. This role is accountable for maximizing the asset total life cycle value throughout product life cycle. It requires strong expertise in obtaining, sustaining, and optimizing product pricing & reimbursement, and a comprehensive understanding of the payer environment in key international markets.

Key Responsibilities:
• Lead the Market Access inline team in one Therapeutic Areas (TAs). Build, mentor, and lead a high-performing global market access inline team, fostering a culture of collaboration, innovation, inclusion, and accountability.
• Serve as a key member of the global Market Access Leadership Team (MALT), contributing to the development and execution of functional strategy, operations, and capability building.
• Accountable for Market Access deliverables during the inline phase, continuously refining and improving standards for these deliverables.
• Collaborate with Medical Affairs, Marketing, and other partner functions to influence brand strategy and execution, ensuring proper integration of market access considerations.
• Keep abreast with payer policies and regulations, economic data within the assigned TA in key international markets. Identify market access opportunities and risks, capture opportunities, mitigate risks through proactive planning, scenario analysis, and stakeholder engagement.
• Deliver and periodically update the Global Value Dossier as a foundational document for affiliate Pricing & Reimbursement (P&R) and Health Technology Assessment (HTA) submissions and resubmissions.
• Provide guidance and support to country teams in P&R and HTA submissions, negotiations, and authority responses, ensuring alignment with global strategies.
• Optimize payer value propositions (PVPs) and health economic models to effectively communicate the clinical and economic value of inline assets to payers and other key stakeholders.
• Continuously drive the development of lifecycle payer evidence and optimize pricing strategies to maintain and enhance P&R throughout the product lifecycle.
• Provide systematic market access insights for forecasting and long-range planning, including analysis of key payer policy changes, risk assessments, and opportunity identification.
• Represent CSL at global trade associations, participating in access-related committees and working groups to influence industry standards and practices.

Qualifications:
• At least 12 years of experience in market access, with significant exposure to diverse healthcare systems in the international markets.
• Proven track record of leading and developing high-performing teams in a global, crossfunctional environment. A role model of collaboration, innovation, inclusion, and accountability.
• Proven track record in obtaining, sustaining, and optimizing pricing, reimbursement, and patient access across diverse healthcare systems in international markets.
• Extensive knowledge of global healthcare systems, payer landscapes, and the interplay between market access and international markets.
• Proven ability to deliver superior performance across diverse healthcare systems in the international markets.
• An advanced degree in Health Economics, Public Health, or a related field is required.

About CSL Vifor
CSL Vifor is a global partner of choice for pharmaceuticals and innovative, leading therapies in iron deficiency and nephrology. We specialize in strategic global partnering, in-licensing and developing, manufacturing and marketing pharmaceutical products for precision healthcare, aiming to help patients around the world lead better, healthier lives. Headquartered in St. Gallen, Switzerland, CSL Vifor also includes the joint company Vifor Fresenius Medical Care Renal Pharma (with Fresenius Medical Care). The parent company, CSL, headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, employs 32,000 people

jobs.description:
Wer wir sind
CSL Behring ist ein weltweit führendes Biotherapeutika-Unternehmen, das sich der Entwicklung und Bereitstellung lebensrettender Therapien widmet. Mit unseren innovativen Produkten leisten wir einen entscheidenden Beitrag zur Behandlung schwerer und seltener Erkrankungen und verbessern die Lebensqualität von Patientinnen und Patienten weltweit.
Zur Verstärkung unserer HR-Organisation in St. Gallen suchen wir eine erfahrene Persönlichkeit als Senior HR Business Partner Manufacturing (all genders) , die unsere Produktionsbereiche strategisch und operativ unterstützt und aktiv zur Weiterentwicklung unserer leistungs- und werteorientierten Unternehmenskultur beiträgt.

Ihre Rolle
Als Senior HR Business Partner sind Sie eine zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen HR und dem Business. Sie arbeiten eng mit Führungskräften, globalen HR-Teams sowie internen und externen Partnern zusammen und tragen maßgeblich zur Umsetzung unserer HR-Strategie im Produktionsumfeld bei.

Ihre Aufgaben

• Umsetzung der globalen und segment-spezifischen HR-Strategie auf regionaler und lokaler Ebene

• Beratung und Unterstützung von Führungskräften und Mitarbeitenden entlang des gesamten Employee Lifecycles (Recruiting, Onboarding, Entwicklung, Performance Management, Retention, Offboarding)

• Coaching von Führungskräften zu Führungsthemen, Mitarbeiterentwicklung und Engagement

• Sicherstellung der konsistenten Anwendung globaler HR-Richtlinien unter Berücksichtigung lokaler rechtlicher und kultureller Anforderungen

• Unterstützung von Organisationsveränderungen (z. B. Reorganisationen, Rollenanpassungen) inkl. Kommunikation und Change-Begleitung

• Förderung einer inklusiven, leistungsstarken und gesundheitsorientierten Unternehmenskultur

• Analyse von HR-Kennzahlen zur Ableitung von Handlungsempfehlungen für das Management

• Unterstützung von Talent- und Nachfolgeplanungsprozessen in enger Zusammenarbeit mit HR-Kolleginnen und -Kollegen

• Sicherstellung der Compliance mit arbeitsrechtlichen Vorgaben in Zusammenarbeit mit Employee Relations, Legal und Compliance

• Vorleben und aktive Förderung unserer Unternehmenswerte

Ihr Profil

• Abgeschlossenes Studium in Human Resources, Betriebswirtschaft oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich (Master oder HR-Zertifizierung wie SHRM/CIPD von Vorteil)

• Mindestens 7 Jahre relevante HR-Erfahrung, idealerweise in einem globalen oder matrixorganisierten Umfeld

• Fundierte Kenntnisse in zentralen HR-Disziplinen sowie im Arbeitsrecht

• Erfahrung in der Unterstützung von HR-Initiativen und Veränderungsprozessen

• Ausgeprägte Organisations- und Projektmanagementfähigkeiten

• Sicherer Umgang mit HR-Systemen sowie Microsoft Office

• Verhandlungssichere Englischkenntnisse, weitere Sprachen von Vorteil

Ihre Kompetenzen

• Starke Umsetzungsfähigkeit in HR-Prozessen und -Programmen

• Beratungsstärke im Umgang mit Führungskräften

• Hohes Urteilsvermögen und ausgeprägtes Risikobewusstsein

• Fähigkeit zur Unterstützung von Change- und Transformationsprozessen

• Daten- und analysebasierte Arbeitsweise

• Ausgeprägte Team- und Netzwerkfähigkeit

• Überzeugende Kommunikations- und Einflussfähigkeit

• Integrität, Diskretion und Vertrauenswürdigkeit

• Hohe Flexibilität, Belastbarkeit und interkulturelle Sensibilität

About CSL Behring
CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients’ needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas. We use three strategic scientific platforms of plasma fractionation, recombinant protein technology, and cell and gene therapy to support continued innovation and continually refine ways in which products can address unmet medical needs and help patients lead full lives.

CSL Behring operates one of the world’s largest plasma collection network

Wer wir sind
CSL Behring ist ein weltweit führendes Biotherapeutika-Unternehmen, das sich der Entwicklung und Bereitstellung lebensrettender Therapien widmet. Mit unseren innovativen Produkten leisten wir einen entscheidenden Beitrag zur Behandlung schwerer und seltener Erkrankungen und verbessern die Lebensqualität von Patientinnen und Patienten weltweit.
Zur Verstärkung unserer HR-Organisation in St. Gallen suchen wir eine erfahrene Persönlichkeit als Senior HR Business Partner Manufacturing (all genders) , die unsere Produktionsbereiche strategisch und operativ unterstützt und aktiv zur Weiterentwicklung unserer leistungs- und werteorientierten Unternehmenskultur beiträgt.

Ihre Rolle
Als Senior HR Business Partner sind Sie eine zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen HR und dem Business. Sie arbeiten eng mit Führungskräften, globalen HR-Teams sowie internen und externen Partnern zusammen und tragen maßgeblich zur Umsetzung unserer HR-Strategie im Produktionsumfeld bei.

Ihre Aufgaben

• Umsetzung der globalen und segment-spezifischen HR-Strategie auf regionaler und lokaler Ebene

• Beratung und Unterstützung von Führungskräften und Mitarbeitenden entlang des gesamten Employee Lifecycles (Recruiting, Onboarding, Entwicklung, Performance Management, Retention, Offboarding)

• Coaching von Führungskräften zu Führungsthemen, Mitarbeiterentwicklung und Engagement

• Sicherstellung der konsistenten Anwendung globaler HR-Richtlinien unter Berücksichtigung lokaler rechtlicher und kultureller Anforderungen

• Unterstützung von Organisationsveränderungen (z. B. Reorganisationen, Rollenanpassungen) inkl. Kommunikation und Change-Begleitung

• Förderung einer inklusiven, leistungsstarken und gesundheitsorientierten Unternehmenskultur

• Analyse von HR-Kennzahlen zur Ableitung von Handlungsempfehlungen für das Management

• Unterstützung von Talent- und Nachfolgeplanungsprozessen in enger Zusammenarbeit mit HR-Kolleginnen und -Kollegen

• Sicherstellung der Compliance mit arbeitsrechtlichen Vorgaben in Zusammenarbeit mit Employee Relations, Legal und Compliance

• Vorleben und aktive Förderung unserer Unternehmenswerte

Ihr Profil

• Abgeschlossenes Studium in Human Resources, Betriebswirtschaft oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich (Master oder HR-Zertifizierung wie SHRM/CIPD von Vorteil)

• Mindestens 7 Jahre relevante HR-Erfahrung, idealerweise in einem globalen oder matrixorganisierten Umfeld

• Fundierte Kenntnisse in zentralen HR-Disziplinen sowie im Arbeitsrecht

• Erfahrung in der Unterstützung von HR-Initiativen und Veränderungsprozessen

• Ausgeprägte Organisations- und Projektmanagementfähigkeiten

• Sicherer Umgang mit HR-Systemen sowie Microsoft Office

• Verhandlungssichere Englischkenntnisse, weitere Sprachen von Vorteil

Ihre Kompetenzen

• Starke Umsetzungsfähigkeit in HR-Prozessen und -Programmen

• Beratungsstärke im Umgang mit Führungskräften

• Hohes Urteilsvermögen und ausgeprägtes Risikobewusstsein

• Fähigkeit zur Unterstützung von Change- und Transformationsprozessen

• Daten- und analysebasierte Arbeitsweise

• Ausgeprägte Team- und Netzwerkfähigkeit

• Überzeugende Kommunikations- und Einflussfähigkeit

• Integrität, Diskretion und Vertrauenswürdigkeit

• Hohe Flexibilität, Belastbarkeit und interkulturelle Sensibilität

About CSL Behring
CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients’ needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas. We use three strategic scientific platforms of plasma fractionation, recombinant protein technology, and cell and gene therapy to support continued innovation and continually refine ways in which products can address unmet medical needs and help patients lead full lives.

CSL Behring operates one of the world’s largest plasma collection network

jobs.title: Design & Technology Lead

titleByLocale.fr: Responsable de la conception et de la technologie

jobs.description:
Job Description

Position Summary

The Technology & Design Lead is responsible for:

Design ownership and governance across Tier 1 capital projects ($50M+), ensuring alignment with business objectives, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices.

Provide process technology leadership with a focus on aseptic processing. The position ensures robust process definition, system ownership, and ongoing manufacturing support for aseptic equipment operations, fostering consistency and innovation in design and technology execution globally.

Key
• Responsibilities

Design Element

Establish and maintain appropriate engineering design standards to ensure consistency across all CapEx projects.

Develop and manage a knowledge management program to ensure all design content is available and understood globally and at site levels.

Lead conceptual and detailed design phases for Tier 1 capital projects, ensuring compliance with cGMP, FDA, EMA, and global standards.

Validate design deliverables against project scope, budget, and schedule.

Develop initial project scope, basis of design, and feasibility assessments.

Collaborate with stakeholders to define user requirements and design criteria.

Execute design assurance reviews and health checks at key project milestones.

Identify risks and implement corrective actions to maintain design integrity.

Provide expert advice to site engineering teams on design standards and best practices.

Mentor site engineers and promote knowledge sharing across global teams.

Engage with external design partners and EPC firms to ensure quality and compliance.

Negotiate design-related contracts and manage vendor performance.

Implement digital design tools and BIM methodologies for efficiency.

Drive sustainability and modular design strategies in capital projects.

Process Technology

Serve as the global subject matter expert for aseptic processing technologies, ensuring best-in-class practices in project definition and system ownership.

Lead the development and implementation of process technology strategies for aseptic manufacturing, including equipment selection, process flow, and integration with facility design.

Define and own process technology requirements during project scoping, ensuring alignment with regulatory and business needs.

Oversee the specification, design, and qualification of aseptic processing systems and equipment.

Provide technical leadership and support for technology transfer, scale-up, and commissioning of aseptic processes.

Act as system owner for aseptic process technologies, maintaining lifecycle documentation and ensuring ongoing compliance.

Support manufacturing operations by troubleshooting and resolving complex issues related to aseptic equipment and processes.

Collaborate with manufacturing, quality, and engineering teams to drive continuous improvement in aseptic operations.

Ensure robust training and knowledge transfer for aseptic process technologies across global sites.

Monitor industry trends and regulatory changes, adapting process technology strategies as needed to maintain competitive advantage and compliance.

Required
• Qualifications

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical, Civil, or related discipline).

12+ years in engineering design and process technology for GMP-regulated facilities, with at least 8 years in leadership roles.

Proven track record in Tier 1 capital project design, assurance, and aseptic process technology leadership.

PMP or equivalent; LEED or sustainability certification preferred.

Strong knowledge of biopharma facility design, aseptic processing, clean utilities, HVAC, and process systems.

Familiarity with ISPE Baseline Guides, ASTM E2500, and risk-based design approaches.

Experience with biologics, cell & gene therapy, or sterile manufacturing facilities.

Proficiency in BIM, AutoCAD, and digital design platforms.

Global mindset and ability to work in a matrix organiz

descriptionByLocale.it:
Mansioni - Tecnologia e Design Lead
• Requisiti - Laurea o Master in Ingegneria (meccanica, elettrica, chimica, civile, o disciplina correlata) - 12+ anni di progettazione ingegneristica e tecnologia di processo per strutture regolamentate GMP, con almeno 8 anni di ruoli di leadership - Proven track record in Tier 1 capital project design, garanzia e leadership tecnologica di processo asettico - PMP o equivalente; la certificazione LEED o sostenibilità preferita - Forte conoscenza della progettazione di impianti biofarmaci, elaborazione asettica, utilità pulite, HVAC e sistemi di processo - Familiarità con ISPE Baseline Guides, ASTM E2500 e approcci di progettazione basati sui rischi - Esperienza con biologici, terapia cellulare e genica, o strutture di produzione sterili - Proficienza nelle piattaforme di progettazione BIM, AutoCAD e Digital - mentalità globale e capacità di lavorare in un'organizzazione di matrice Cosa? - Elemento di progettazione - Stabilire e mantenere adeguati standard di progettazione ingegneristica per garantire la coerenza in tutti i progetti CapEx. - Sviluppare e gestire un programma di gestione della conoscenza per garantire che tutti i contenuti di progettazione siano disponibili e compresi a livello globale e a livello del sito. - Lead fasi di progettazione concettuale e dettagliata per i progetti di capitale Tier 1, assicurando la conformità a cGMP, FDA, EMA e standard globali. - Convalidare i progetti consegnabili contro la portata del progetto, il budget e il calendario. - Sviluppare la portata iniziale del progetto, la base della progettazione e le valutazioni di fattibilità. - Collabora con gli stakeholder per definire i requisiti degli utenti e i criteri di progettazione. - Esegui recensioni di garanzia del design e controlli sulla salute nelle pietre miliari del progetto chiave. - Identificare i rischi e implementare azioni correttive per mantenere l'integrità del design. - Fornire consulenza esperta ai team di ingegneria del sito sugli standard di progettazione e le migliori pratiche. - Gli ingegneri del sito Mentor e promuovere la condivisione delle conoscenze in team globali. - Impegnarsi con partner esterni di progettazione e aziende di EPC per garantire qualità e conformità. - Negoziare contratti relativi alla progettazione e gestire le prestazioni del fornitore. - Implementare strumenti di progettazione digitale e metodologie BIM per l'efficienza. - Promuovere la sostenibilità e le strategie di progettazione modulare nei progetti di capitale. - Tecnologia di processo - Servire come esperto di materia globale per le tecnologie di elaborazione asettica, assicurando le best-in-class pratiche nella definizione del progetto e la proprietà del sistema. - Guidare lo sviluppo e l'implementazione di strategie di tecnologia di processo per la produzione asettica, tra cui la selezione di attrezzature, il flusso di processo e l'integrazione con la progettazione di impianti. - Definire e possedere i requisiti di tecnologia di processo durante la valutazione del progetto, garantendo l'allineamento con le esigenze normative e aziendali. - supervisionare le specifiche, la progettazione e la qualificazione dei sistemi di elaborazione asettica e delle attrezzature. - Fornire la leadership tecnica e il supporto per il trasferimento tecnologico, la scala e la messa in servizio dei processi asettici. - Agire come proprietario di sistema per tecnologie di processo asettiche, mantenere la documentazione del ciclo di vita e garantire la conformità in corso. - Supporta le operazioni di produzione mediante la risoluzione dei problemi e la risoluzione di problemi complessi relativi alle apparecchiature e ai processi asettici. - Collabora con team di produzione, qualità e ingegneria per migliorare continuamente le operazioni asettiche. - Assicurare una formazione robusta e un trasferimento di conoscenze per le tecnologie di processo asettiche nei siti globali. - Monitorare le tendenze del settore e i cambiamenti normativi, adattare le strategie di tecnologia di processo necessarie per mantenere il vantaggio competitivo e la conformità. Contatto

• Cosa offriamo - Designelement - Festlegung und Aufrechterhaltung geeigneter Engineering-Design-Standards, um die Konsistenz aller CapEx-Projekte zu gewährleisten. Entwickeln und verwalten Sie ein Wissensmanagement-Programm, um sicherzustellen, dass alle Design-Inhalte weltweit und auf Standortebene verfügbar und verstanden werden. Leiten Sie konzeptionelle und detaillierte Entwurfsphasen für Tier-1-Kapitalprojekte, um die Einhaltung der cGMP-, FDA-, EMA- und globalen Standards sicherzustellen. Validieren Sie die Designergebnisse anhand von Projektumfang, Budget und Zeitplan. - Entwicklung des anfänglichen Projektumfangs, der Entwurfsgrundlage und der Machbarkeitsbewertungen. - Arbeiten Sie mit Stakeholdern zusammen, um Benutzeranforderungen und Designkriterien zu definieren. - Durchführung von Design Assurance Reviews und Gesundheitschecks an wichtigen Meilensteinen des Projekts. - Identifizieren Sie Risiken und implementieren Sie Korrekturmaßnahmen, um die Integrität des Designs zu erhalten. - Bereitstellung fachkundiger Beratung für Bauingenieurteams zu Designstandards und Best Practices. Mentoring-Website-Ingenieure und fördern den Wissensaustausch in globalen Teams. - Engagieren Sie sich mit externen Designpartnern und EPC-Firmen, um Qualität und Compliance sicherzustellen. - Verhandeln Sie designbezogene Verträge und verwalten Sie die Leistung des Anbieters. Implementieren Sie digitale Design-Tools und BIM-Methoden für Effizienz. - Förderung von Nachhaltigkeit und modularen Designstrategien in Kapitalprojekten. - Prozesstechnik - Dienen Sie als globaler Fachexperte für aseptische Verarbeitungstechnologien und gewährleisten Sie Best-in-Class-Praktiken in der Projektdefinition und im Systembesitz. - Führen Sie die Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Prozesstechnologiestrategien für die aseptische Fertigung, einschließlich der Geräteauswahl, des Prozessflusses und der Integration in das Anlagendesign. - Definieren und eigene Prozesstechnologieanforderungen während des Projekt-Scopings, um die Ausrichtung auf regulatorische und geschäftliche
• Anforderungen sicherzustellen. Beaufsichtigen Sie die Spezifikation, das Design und die Qualifikation von aseptischen Verarbeitungssystemen und -geräten. - Bereitstellung von technischer Führung und Unterstützung für Technologietransfer, Skalierung und Inbetriebnahme von aseptischen Prozessen. - Handeln Sie als Systembesitzer für aseptische Prozesstechnologien, pflegen Sie die Lebenszyklusdokumentation und gewährleisten Sie die kontinuierliche Einhaltung. - Unterstützung der Fertigung durch Fehlersuche und Lösung komplexer Probleme im Zusammenhang mit aseptischen Geräten und Prozessen. - Zusammenarbeit mit Fertigungs-, Qualitäts- und Ingenieurteams, um die kontinuierliche Verbesserung der aseptischen Operationen voranzutreiben. Gewährleistung eines robusten Trainings und Wissenstransfers für aseptische Prozesstechnologien an globalen Standorten. - Überwachung von Branchentrends und regulatorischen Änderungen, Anpassung von Prozesstechnologiestrategien nach Bedarf, um Wettbewerbsvorteile und Compliance zu erhalten. Mansioni - Technologie et conception
• Requisiti - Baccalauréat en génie (mécanique, électrique, chimique, civil ou discipline connexe) - 12 ans et plus en conception technique et en technologie des procédés pour les installations réglementées par les BPF, avec au moins 8 ans de rôles de direction - Expérience éprouvée dans la conception, l'assurance et le leadership technologique des projets d'immobilisations de niveau 1 - PMP ou équivalent; LEED ou certification de durabilité préférée - Bonne connaissance de la conception des installations biopharmaceutiques, du traitement aseptique, des services publics propres, du CVC et des systèmes de traitement - Connaissance des guides de base de l'ISPE, de l'ASTM E2500 et des approches de conception axées sur le risque - Expérience en biologie, en thérapie cellulaire et génique ou en installations de fabrication stériles - Compétence en BIM, AutoCAD et plateformes de conception numérique - L'état d'esprit et la capacité de travailler dans une organisation matricielle
• Cosa offriamo - Élément de conception - Établir et maintenir des normes de conception appropriées pour assurer la cohérence de tous les projets CapEx. - Élaborer et gérer un programme de gestion des connaissances pour s'assurer que tout le contenu de conception est disponible et compris à l'échelle mondiale et au niveau du site. - Diriger les phases de conception conceptuelle et détaillée pour les projets d'immobilisations de niveau 1, en veillant à la conformité avec le GMPc, la FDA, l'EMA et les normes mondiales. - Valider les produits livrables en fonction de la portée, du budget et du calendrier du projet. - Élaborer la portée initiale du projet, la base de la conception et les évaluations de faisabilité. - Collaborer avec les parties prenantes pour définir les besoins des utilisateurs et les critères de conception. - Exécuter des examens d'assurance de la conception et des vérifications de la santé aux étapes clés du projet. - Identifier les risques et mettre en oeuvre des mesures correctives pour maintenir l'intégrité de la conception. - Fournir des conseils d'experts aux équipes d'ingénierie du site sur les normes de conception et les meilleures pratiques. - Mentor ingénieur site et promouvoir le partage des connaissances entre les équipes mondiales. - S'engager auprès de partenaires externes de conception et d'entreprises EPC pour assurer la qualité et la conformité. - Négocier des contrats liés à la conception et gérer le rendement des fournisseurs. - Mettre en œuvre des outils de conception numérique et des méthodologies BIM pour l'efficacité. - Favoriser des stratégies de développement durable et de conception modulaire dans les projets d'immobilisations. - Technologie des procédés - Servir d'expert mondial en matière de technologies de traitement aseptique, assurant les meilleures pratiques en classe dans la définition des projets et la propriété des systèmes. - Diriger l'élaboration et la mise en oeuvre de stratégies technologiques pour la fabrication aseptique, y compris la sélection des équipements, le débit des procédés et l'intégration à la conception des installations. - Définir les exigences en matière de technologie des procédés et s'y conformer pendant la détermination de la portée du projet, en veillant à ce qu'elles correspondent aux besoins réglementaires et opérationnels. - Surveiller la spécification, la conception et la qualification des systèmes et équipements de traitement aseptique. - Fournir un leadership technique et un soutien pour le transfert de technologie, l'expansion et la mise en service des processus aseptiques. - Agir en tant que propriétaire de système pour les technologies de procédé aseptique, maintenir la documentation du cycle de vie et assurer la conformité continue. - Soutenir les opérations de fabrication par le dépannage et la résolution de problèmes complexes liés aux équipements et procédés aseptiques. - Collaborer avec des équipes de fabrication, de qualité et d'ingénierie pour améliorer continuellement les opérations aseptiques. - Assurer une formation solide et un transfert de connaissances pour les technologies de procédé aseptique dans tous les sites mondiaux. - Surveiller les tendances de l'industrie et les changements réglementaires, en adaptant les stratégies technologiques de processus au besoin pour maintenir l'avantage concurrentiel et la conformité. jobs.title: Principal, Clinical Data Management Lead

titleByLocale.fr: Programmeur Principal (Supervision des Données et Normes)

jobs.description:
The Principal, Clinical Data Management Lead provides leadership and oversight for clinical data build, programming, and vendor deliverables across in-house, hybrid, and outsourced studies, ensuring alignment with CSL standards, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices .

The role drives governance, review, and validation processes; leads the implementation of CDASH and SDTM standards; and oversees scalable validation frameworks and data quality controls . Additionally, it ensures effective integration of internal and external data into platforms such as the CSL Clinical Data Warehouse, while advancing automation, AI-driven solutions, and strong cross-functional collaboration with Biostatistics, Data Management, Standards, and external partners

Main Responsibilities and Accountabilities:

• Leads and develops a team of Clinical Data Validators, providing direction on clinical data standards, validation, and oversight activities across in-house, hybrid, and vendor-supported studies.

• Establishes and drives clinical data governance frameworks, including review and validation processes for eCRF builds, SDTM datasets, specifications, and vendor deliverables, ensuring compliance with internal standards, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices.

• Oversees the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of clinical data standards (e.g., CDASH, SDTM) and associated validation check libraries to enable consistent, scalable, and high-quality data across studies.

• Provides strategic oversight of data integration processes, including external data flows and system interfaces, ensuring accurate, efficient, and compliant data ingestion into downstream platforms such as the Clinical Data Warehouse.

• Ensures submission readiness of clinical data by establishing robust quality control frameworks and validation processes aligned with regulatory expectations (e.g., SDTM, ADaM, define.xml).

• Develops, maintains, and governs departmental and cross-functional SOPs, standards, and QMS documentation related to clinical data oversight, standards, and programming.

• Drives cross-functional alignment by partnering with Biostatistics, Data Management, Standards, and external partners to ensure consistent understanding and application of clinical data standards and quality expectations; provides guidance, knowledge sharing, and targeted training to support effective implementation across studies.

• Provides oversight and guidance on data storage, archival, and retrieval strategies to support regulatory submissions, pooled analyses, and reuse of legacy data in collaboration with Biostatistics and other stakeholders.

• Oversees programming and validation support to ensure availability of high-quality, analysis-ready datasets, while promoting automation, efficiency, and innovation through the use of SAS and emerging technologies (e.g., Python, AI-driven solutions).

Job Qualifications and Experience Requirements:
Education

• Degree (BSc/MSc/Diploma) in Computer Science, Mathematics/Statistics, or related area with relevant experience.

• Other degrees and certifications considered, if commensurate with related data management/statistical programming experience

Experience

• At least 7 years of relevant experience with EDC and/or Clinical Data Warehouse platforms (e.g., Medidata Rave, Veeva Vault), with a solid understanding of data flows, integrations, and database structures within the CRO/pharmaceutical environment

• Significant experience with demonstrated leadership or oversight responsibilities and a strong understanding of the end-to-end clinical data lifecycle, including data collection, validation, standards implementation, and regulatory submission requirements.

• Proven expertise in CDISC standards ( CDASH, SDTM, ADaM) and their practical application across studies, including review and oversight of datasets, specifications, and mappings

• Proficiency in SAS programming, with working knowledge
