jobs.description:
The Opportunity:
The Global Occupational Health, Health & Wellness Lead is responsible for designing, governing, and continuously improving a global strategy and operating model for occupational health (OH), industrial hygiene (IH), workers’ compensation case management, and employee wellness. This role ensures compliance, protects and promotes worker health, reduces injury-related risk, and supports business performance across all global operations.
Scope & Impact-

• Global strategy and oversight for OH, IH, wellness, ergonomics, mental health (ISO 45003), biosafety, and medical governance.

• Workers’ compensation leadership in the U.S. including claims governance, medical oversight, and return-to-work integration.

• Oversight of international injury management frameworks including Early Intervention programs and optimization of self-insurance injury management in Australia.

• Collaboration with EHS, HR, Legal/Privacy, Risk/Insurance, Business Continuity, Facilities, and site leadership globally.

• Provide expert analysis to evaluate and determine the optimal operating model for all Occupational Health and Wellness functions, identifying best case solutions that maximize efficiency through the strategic use of internal and external resources, and lead the implementation of the recommended model.

The Role:

• Develop and implement a global OH & Wellness strategy aligned with EHS vision.

• Lead U.S. workers’ compensation programs, ensuring compliant handling, medical quality, and efficient claim resolution.

• Establish global standards, clinical protocols, and IH governance systems.

• Lead global case management including early communication, functional capacity evaluations, and accommodation assessments.

• Govern Australian self-insurance injury management systems and compliance audits.

• Oversee international Early Intervention programs focusing on rapid triage and injury minimization.

• Provide biosafety oversight in R&D settings.

• Lead OH/IH global teams and manage external vendor performance.

• Own global OH/IH data systems, KPIs, and reporting.

Skills & Experience:

• Advanced clinical or scientific degree (MD/DO, NP/PA with OH focus, MS OH/IH).

• 10+ years OH/IH leadership in multinational or regulated industries.

• Strong experience with U.S. workers’ compensation programs.

• Knowledge of Australian self-insurance injury management and Early Intervention programs.

• Familiarity with OSHA, EU OSH, ISO 45001/45003, and ACGIH/NIOSH frameworks.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Board certification in Occupational Medicine or CIH/COH.

• Experience leading global workers’ compensation transformation.

• Implementation of global OH digital systems.

• Experience with ESG metrics and cross-cultural leadership.

• Strategic leadership and influence.

• Clinical and technical rigor.

• Data-driven decision-making.

• Change management and communication excellence.

• Inclusive leadership and global team development.

About CSL Behring
CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients’ needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas. We use three strategic scientific platforms of plasma fractionation, recombinant protein technology, and cell and gene therapy to support continued innovation and continually refine ways in which products can address unmet medical needs and help patients lead full lives.

CSL Behring operates one of the world’s largest plasma collection networks, CSL Plasma. Our parent company, CSL, headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, employs 32,000 people, and delivers its lifesaving therapies to people in more than 100 countries.
To learn more about CSL, CSL Behring, CSL Seqirus and CSL Vifor visit https://www.csl.com/ and CSL Plasma at https://www

L'opportunità: Il Global Occupational Health, Health & Wellness Lead è responsabile della progettazione, del governo e del continuo miglioramento di una strategia globale e del modello operativo per la salute sul lavoro (OH), dell’igiene industriale (IH), della gestione dei casi di compensazione dei lavoratori e del benessere dei dipendenti. Questo ruolo garantisce la conformità, protegge e promuove la salute dei lavoratori, riduce il rischio legato alle lesioni e supporta le prestazioni aziendali in tutte le operazioni globali. Scope & Impact-
• Strategia globale e supervisione per OH, IH, benessere, ergonomia, salute mentale (ISO 45003), biosicurezza e governance medica.
• La leadership di risarcimento dei lavoratori negli Stati Uniti, tra cui la governance dei reclami, la supervisione medica e l'integrazione di ritorno al lavoro.
• La supervisione dei quadri di gestione delle lesioni internazionali, compresi i programmi di Intervento precoce e l'ottimizzazione della gestione delle lesioni auto-assicurazione in Australia.
• Collaborazione con EHS, HR, Legale/Privacy, Risk/Insurance, Business Continuity, Servizi e Leader del sito a livello globale.
• Fornire un'analisi esperta per valutare e determinare il modello operativo ottimale per tutte le funzioni di Occupational Health and Wellness, identificare le migliori soluzioni di casi che massimizzano l'efficienza attraverso l'uso strategico delle risorse interne ed esterne, e condurre l'implementazione del modello consigliato. Il ruolo:
• Sviluppare e implementare una strategia globale OH & Wellness allineata alla visione EHS.
• Guidare i programmi di compensazione dei lavoratori degli Stati Uniti, assicurando la gestione conforme, la qualità medica e la risoluzione di reclamo efficiente.
• Stabilire standard globali, protocolli clinici e sistemi di governance IH.
• Leader globale gestione dei casi, tra cui la comunicazione precoce, le valutazioni delle capacità funzionali e le valutazioni degli alloggi.
• Governare i sistemi di gestione delle lesioni autoassicurazione australiana e controlli di conformità.
• Superare i programmi internazionali di intervento precoce che si concentrano sulla riduzione rapida del triage e delle lesioni.
• Fornire la supervisione della biosicurezza nelle impostazioni R&D.
• Condurre team globali OH/IH e gestire le prestazioni dei fornitori esterni.
• I propri sistemi di dati globali OH/IH, KPI e reporting. Competenze & Esperienza:
• Grado clinico o scientifico avanzato (MD/DO, NP/PA con focus OH, MS OH/IH).
• 10+ anni OH/IH leadership nelle industrie multinazionali o regolamentate.
• Forte esperienza con i programmi di compensazione dei lavoratori degli Stati Uniti.
• Conoscenza della gestione delle lesioni da autoassicurazione australiana e dei programmi di intervento precoce.
• Familiarità con OSHA, OSH UE, ISO 45001/45003, e ACGIH/NIOSH framework. Preferiti:
• Certificazione del consiglio in Medicina del lavoro o CIH/COH.
• Esperienza che conduce la trasformazione globale della compensazione dei lavoratori.
• Attuazione dei sistemi digitali OH globali.
• Esperienza con metriche ESG e leadership interculturale.
• Leader e influenza strategica.
• Rigor clinico e tecnico.
• Decisioni basate sui dati.
• Cambiare la gestione e l'eccellenza della comunicazione.
• Leadership inclusiva e sviluppo globale del team. Informazioni su CSL Behring CSL Behring è un leader globale di biotherapeutics guidato dalla nostra promessa di salvare vite. Concentrati sulle esigenze dei pazienti utilizzando le più recenti tecnologie, scopriamo, sviluppiamo e forniamo terapie innovative per le persone che vivono con condizioni di immunologia, ematologia, cardiovascolare e metabolica, respiratoria e trapianto aree terapeutiche. Utilizziamo tre piattaforme scientifiche strategiche di frazionamento del plasma, tecnologia delle proteine ricombinanti, e terapia cellulare e genica per supportare l'innovazione continua e perfezionare continuamente i modi in cui i prodotti possono affrontare bisogni medici non soddisfatti e aiutare i pazienti a condurre una vita piena. CSL Behring gestisce una delle più grandi reti di raccolta al plasma del mondo, CSL Plasma. La nostra società madre, CSL, con sede a Melbourne, Australia, impiega 32.000 persone, e fornisce le sue terapie salvavita per le persone in più di 100 paesi. Per saperne di più su CSL, CSL Behring, CSL Seqirus e CSL Vifor visita https://www.csl.com/ e CSL Plasma https://www.

jobs.description:
CSL is transforming its R&D organization to accelerate innovation and create greater impact for patients. With a streamlined, project-led structure and a focus on collaboration, we're building a future-ready team that excels in dynamic biotech ecosystems. Joining CSL now means being part of an agile team committed to developing therapies that make a meaningful difference worldwide.

Could you be our next Senior Clinical Scientist? The job is in our King of Prussia, PA or Glattbrugg Switzerland office. This is a hybrid position and is onsite three days a week.

Reporting to a Global Clinical Scientist Lead, you will support multifunctional, clinical projects in the Cardiovascular-Renal Therapeutic Area. You will work with the Program Director and other Clinical Scientists in performing delegated tasks to support the clinical development program as dictated by therapeutic area/ project needs.

The Role

• Help develop individual clinical studies according to the clinical development plan within the assigned therapeutic area.

• Provide scientific input for the safe and efficient execution of assigned studies, ensuring the highest quality and full compliance of all outputs.

• Help develop high-quality program and study level documents and training materials aligned with project plans (e.g. clinical development plan, IB, protocols, eCRF, ICF, study reference manuals, investigator trainings, clinical study report and regulatory submission documents) in compliance with federal regulations, GCP and good medical practice. regulatory submission documents

• Provide clinical science input into design and review of eCRF, SAP, and TLFs.

• Support the scientific data analysis and interpretation and help write clinical study reports, internal and external scientific meeting presentations, and publications.

• Support the medical monitoring and oversight of individual clinical studies with an emphasis on subject safety and eligibility, data integrity, trend identification, analysis and remediation, including ongoing review of blinded data, use of data visualization tools and programmed reports.

• Identify clinical data trends, issue and resolve corresponding queries, ensure consistency of medical coding and other important data and identification of cases for medical review. Ensure all questions / issues requiring medical oversight are brought to the attention of the Medical monitor.

• Manage the processes and partnerships required to support external study oversight committees (e.g. Steering committee, independent data monitoring committee, clinical events committee).

• Collaborate with internal and external partners to ensure translation of the clinical protocol into operational deliverables, serve as primary contact for protocol guidance, provide training to the clinical execution team.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree, or equivalent with minimum of 5 years' experience in the biotechnology or pharmaceutical industry (or biomedical research organization) required; OR Advanced degree (Master's, PhD) with relevant clinical focus and minimum 3 years experience

• Knowledge in the drug development processes for pharmaceuticals with experience in biotherapeutics desirable (e.g. therapeutic proteins, monoclonal antibodies), and demonstrated ability to use systems and tools (e.g., EDC systems) for data collection, analysis and reporting.

• The ability to work collaboratively in a matrix environment is necessary.

• Experience working with CROs and AROs, including providing oversight.

• Proficient knowledge and technical skills to support study specific data review, trend identification, data interpretation

jobs.description:
Two Directors of Search & Evaluation to lead strategic sourcing and evaluation of external innovation opportunities in Hematology, and Cardiovascular/Renal therapeutic areas. Embedded within each Therapeutic Area Leadership Team (TALT), these leaders will identify and advance high-potential assets from preclinical through Phase 1 clinical stages, shape early partnering strategies, and drive transactions in collaboration with Business Development ​

We have a hybrid office/home working model. The position will be based in Zurich (preferred) or Maidenhead, UK, with significant business travel

Main Responsibilities & Accountabilities ​

• Serve as the senior Early S&E leader within the TALT, influencing therapeutic strategy and ensuring external innovation priorities are integrated into portfolio planning. ​

• Lead proactive sourcing and scouting efforts for preclinical and Phase 1 assets, building a robust pipeline of opportunities aligned with TA strategy. ​

• Co-lead internal meetings (with Late Search Lead) focused on evaluating and prioritizing New Product Opportunities (NPOs) within each CSL’s therapeutic areas. NPO meetings are strategic checkpoints where cross-functional teams review potential assets identified by Search and decide whether to advance them for further due diligence and deal negotiations ​

• Develop and execute early partnering strategies, including onboarding approaches and competitive positioning for priority assets. ​

• Drive cross-functional due diligence for each opportunity, coordinating scientific, clinical, regulatory, and commercial assessments to inform governance decisions. ​

• Transaction Execution: Partner closely with BD and Regional Ecosystem Leads to advance high-priority opportunities through negotiation and deal close, ensuring seamless handoff and execution ​

• Represent the TA externally, leading sourcing activities at specialized conferences and cultivating relationships with biotech, academia, and investment communities. ​

Qualifications & Experience Requirements ​

• Significant tenure in biopharma with significant experience in external innovation, search & evaluation, or business development. ​

• Advanced degree required (PhD, MD, or equivalent). ​

• Must have Deep scientific expertise in Hematology or Cardiovascular/Renal therapeutic areas. ​

• Proven track record of leading due diligence and closing early-stage deals. ​

• Strong network within biotech, academia, and pharma BD organizations. ​

About CSL Behring
CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients’ needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas. We use three strategic scientific platforms of plasma fractionation, recombinant protein technology, and cell and gene therapy to support continued innovation and continually refine ways in which products can address unmet medical needs and help patients lead full lives.

CSL Behring operates one of the world’s largest plasma collection networks, CSL Plasma. Our parent company, CSL, headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, employs 32,000 people, and delivers its lifesaving therapies to people in more than 100 countries.
To learn more about CSL, CSL Behring, CSL Seqirus and CSL Vifor visit https://www.csl.com/ and CSL Plasma at https://www.cslplasma.com/ .

Our Benefits
For more information on CSL benefits visit How CSL Supports Your Well-being | CSL .

You Belong at CSL
At CSL, Inclusion and Belonging is at the core of our mission and who we are. It fuels our innovation day in and day out. By celebrating our differences and creating a culture of curiosity and empathy, we are able to better understand and connect with our patients and donors, foster strong relationships with our stakeholders, and sustain a diverse workforc

Le riunioni NPO sono checkpoint strategici dove le squadre cross-funzionali esaminano i potenziali assetti identificati dalla Ricerca e decidono se avanzarli per ulteriori valutazioni e negoziazioni di trattative. - Sviluppare e eseguire strategie di partnering iniziali, comprese le strategie di onboarding e la posizionamento competitivo per gli assetti di priorità. - Guidare la valutazione cross-funzionale per ciascuna opportunità, coordinando le valutazioni scientifiche, cliniche, regolatorie e commerciali per informare le decisioni di governance. - Esecuzione delle trattative: Collaborare strettamente con BD e Regional Ecosystem Leads per avanzare le opportunità di alta priorità attraverso la negoziazione e la chiusura del trattato, assicurando un passaggio senza intoppi e l'esecuzione. - Rappresentare la TA esternamente, guidando le attività di ricerca in conferenze specializzate e coltivando relazioni con la biotecnologia, l'istruzione accademica e le comunità di investimento. ##
• Requisiti e Esperienze - Tenuta significativa nella biotecnologia con esperienza significativa in innovazione esterna, ricerca e valutazione, o sviluppo aziendale. - Laurea specialistica richiesta (PhD, MD, o equivalente). - Deve avere una profonda conoscenza scientifica nelle aree terapeutiche di Ematologia o Cardiovascolare/Renale. - Provenienza di esperienze di leadership nella valutazione e chiusura di trattative iniziali. - Rete forte all'interno della biotecnologia, dell'istruzione accademica e delle organizzazioni di BD farmaceutico. ##
• Cosa offriamo - Modello di lavoro ibrido ufficio/casa. - Posizione basata a Zurigo (preferito) o Maidenhead, Regno Unito, con viaggi d'affari significativi. ## Contatto Per ulteriori informazioni sui benefici di CSL visita [How CSL Supports Your Well-being | CSL](https://www.csl.com/). ## Descrizione CSL Behring è un leader globale di biofarmaceutici guidato dalla nostra promessa di salvare vite. Focalizzati sul servire le esigenze dei pazienti utilizzando le ultime tecnologie, scopriamo, sviluppiamo e consegniamo terapie innovative per le persone che vivono con condizioni nelle aree terapeutiche di immunologia, ematologia, cardiovascolare e metabolica, respiratoria e trapianto. Utilizziamo tre piattaforme scientifiche strategiche di frazionamento del plasma, tecnologia di proteine ricombinanti e terapia cellulare e genica per supportare l'innovazione continua e raffinare continuamente le modalità in cui i prodotti possono affrontare le esigenze mediche non soddisfatte e aiutare i pazienti a condurre vite complete. CSL Behring opera una delle reti di raccolta di plasma più grandi del mondo, CSL Plasma. La nostra società madre, CSL, con sede a Melbourne, Australia, impiega 32.000 persone e consegna le sue terapie salvavita a persone in più di 100 paesi. Per ulteriori informazioni su CSL, CSL Behring, CSL Seqirus e CSL Vifor visita [https://www.csl.com/](https://www.csl.com/) e CSL Plasma a [https://www.cslplasma.com/](https://www.cslplasma.com/).
descriptionByLocale.en:
Two Directors of Search & Evaluation to lead strategic sourcing and evaluation of external innovation opportunities in Hematology, and Cardiovascular/Renal therapeutic areas. Embedded within each Therapeutic Area Leadership Team (TALT), these leaders will identify and advance high-potential assets from preclinical through Phase 1 clinical stages, shape early partnering strategies, and drive transactions in collaboration with Business Development ​

We have a hybrid office/home working model. The position will be based in Zurich (preferred) or Maidenhead, UK, with significant business travel

Main Responsibilities & Accountabilities ​

• Serve as the senior Early S&E leader within the TALT, influencing therapeutic strategy and ensuring external innovation priorities are integrated into portfolio planning. ​

• Lead proactive sourcing and scouting efforts for preclinical and Phase 1 assets, building a robust pipeline of opportunities aligned with TA strategy. ​

• Co-lead internal meetings (with Late Search Lead) focused on evaluating and prioritizing New Product Opportunities (NPOs) within each CSL’s therapeutic areas. NPO meetings are strategic checkpoints where cross-functional teams review potential assets identified by Search and decide whether to advance them for further due diligence and deal negotiations ​

• Develop and execute early partnering strategies, including onboarding approaches and competitive positioning for priority assets. ​

• Drive cross-functional due diligence for each opportunity, coordinating scientific, clinical, regulatory, and commercial assessments to inform governance decisions. ​

• Transaction Execution: Partner closely with BD and Regional Ecosystem Leads to advance high-priority opportunities through negotiation and deal close, ensuring seamless handoff and execution ​

• Represent the TA externally, leading sourcing activities at specialized conferences and cultivating relationships with biotech, academia, and investment communities. ​

Qualifications & Experience Requirements ​

• Significant tenure in biopharma with significant experience in external innovation, search & evaluation, or business development. ​

• Advanced degree required (PhD, MD, or equivalent). ​

• Must have Deep scientific expertise in Hematology or Cardiovascular/Renal therapeutic areas. ​

• Proven track record of leading due diligence and closing early-stage deals. ​

• Strong network within biotech, academia, and pharma BD organizations. ​

About CSL Behring
CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients’ needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas. We use three strategic scientific platforms of plasma fractionation, recombinant protein technology, and cell and gene therapy to support continued innovation and continually refine ways in which products can address unmet medical needs and help patients lead full lives.

CSL Behring operates one of the world’s largest plasma collection networks, CSL Plasma. Our parent company, CSL, headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, employs 32,000 people, and delivers its lifesaving therapies to people in more than 100 countries.
To learn more about CSL, CSL Behring, CSL Seqirus and CSL Vifor visit https://www.csl.com/ and CSL Plasma at https://www.cslplasma.com/ .

Our Benefits
For more information on CSL benefits visit How CSL Supports Your Well-being | CSL .

You Belong at CSL
At CSL, Inclusion and Belonging is at the core of our mission and who we are. It fuels our innovation day in and day out. By celebrating our differences and creating a culture of curiosity and empathy, we are able to better understand and connect with our patients and donors, foster strong relationships with our stakeholders, and sustain a diverse workforc

Mansions - Dienen Sie als Senior Leader von Early S & E innerhalb des TALT, beeinflussen Sie die therapeutische Strategie und stellen Sie sicher, dass externe Innovationsprioritäten in den Portfolioplan integriert werden. - Proaktive Forschungs- und Scouting-Bemühungen für präklinische und Phase 1, Aufbau einer robusten Pipeline von Möglichkeiten, die mit der TA-Strategie ausgerichtet sind - Co-Drive interne Meetings (mit dem Late Search Lead), die sich auf die Bewertung und Priorisierung von New Product Opportunities (NPO) in jedem CSL-Therapiebereich konzentrieren. NPO-Meetings sind strategische Kontrollpunkte, an denen funktionsübergreifende Teams potenzielle Vermögenswerte untersuchen, die von Research identifiziert wurden, und entscheiden, ob sie für weitere Bewertungen und Verhandlungen vorgeschlagen werden sollen. - Entwicklung und Umsetzung erster Partnering-Strategien, einschließlich Onboarding-Strategien und Wettbewerbspositionierung für Prioritäten. - Leitfaden für die funktionsübergreifende Bewertung für jede Gelegenheit, Koordinierung wissenschaftlicher, klinischer, regulatorischer und kommerzieller Bewertungen, um Governance-Entscheidungen zu treffen. - Durchführung der Verhandlungen: Enge Zusammenarbeit mit BD und Regional Ecosystem Leads, um vorrangige Möglichkeiten durch Verhandlungen und Abschluss des Vertrags zu fördern und eine reibungslose Passage und Ausführung zu gewährleisten. - Vertretung der TA nach außen, Leitung von Forschungsaktivitäten in Fachkonferenzen und Pflege von Beziehungen zu Biotechnologie, akademischer Bildung und Investitionsgemeinschaften.
• Anforderungen und Erfahrungen - Bedeutender biotechnologischer Nachlass mit erheblicher Erfahrung in externen Innovationen, Forschung und Bewertung oder Geschäftsentwicklung. - Fachstudium erforderlich (PhD, MD oder gleichwertig). - Er muss über fundierte wissenschaftliche Kenntnisse in den therapeutischen Bereichen Hämatologie oder Herz-Kreislauf / Nieren verfügen. - Nachweis von Führungserfahrungen bei der Bewertung und dem Abschluss der ersten Verhandlungen. Starkes Netzwerk innerhalb der Biotechnologie, der akademischen Bildung und der pharmazeutischen BD-Organisationen. Was wir anbieten - Hybrid-Arbeitsmodell Büro / Haus. - Standort mit Sitz in Zürich (vorzugsweise) oder Maidenhead, Großbritannien, mit bedeutenden Geschäftsreisen. Weitere Informationen zu den Vorteilen von CSL finden Sie unter Wie CSL Ihr Wohlbefinden unterstützt | CSL. Beschreibung CSL Behring ist ein weltweit führender Anbieter von Biopharmazeutika, der von unserem Versprechen geleitet wird, Leben zu retten. Konzentriert auf die Bedürfnisse der Patienten mit den neuesten Technologien, entdecken, entwickeln und liefern wir innovative Therapien für Menschen mit Erkrankungen in den therapeutischen Bereichen Immunologie, Hämatologie, Herz-Kreislauf und Stoffwechsel, Atmung und Transplantation. Wir nutzen drei strategische Wissenschaftsplattformen für die Plasmafraktionierung, rekombinante Proteintechnologie und Zell- und Gentherapie, um kontinuierliche Innovationen zu unterstützen und kontinuierlich zu verfeinern, wie Produkte unbefriedigte medizinische Bedürfnisse erfüllen und Patienten helfen können, ein vollständiges Leben zu führen. CSL Behring betreibt eines der weltweit größten Plasmasammelnetze, CSL Plasma. Unsere Muttergesellschaft CSL mit Sitz in Melbourne, Australien, beschäftigt 32.000 Mitarbeiter und liefert ihre lebensrettenden Therapien an Menschen in mehr als 100 Ländern. Weitere Informationen zu CSL, CSL Behring, CSL Seqirus und CSL Vifor finden Sie unter https://www.csl.com/ und CSL Plasma unter https://www.cslplasma.com/.

Expéditions - Servir de chef de file en S et E précoce au sein du TALT, influer sur la stratégie thérapeutique et veiller à ce que les priorités d'innovation externe soient intégrées au plan du portefeuille. - Mener des efforts proactifs de recherche et de dépistage en vue de la phase 1 préclinique et de l'établissement d'un solide bassin de possibilités aligné sur la stratégie de l'AT. - Codiriger des réunions internes (avec le responsable de la recherche tardive) axées sur l'évaluation et la priorisation des possibilités de nouveaux produits dans chaque domaine thérapeutique de la LSC. Les réunions des administrateurs recrutés sur le plan national sont des points de contrôle stratégiques où les équipes interfonctionnelles examinent les éléments d'actif potentiels identifiés par Recherche et décident s'il y a lieu de les faire avancer en vue de nouvelles évaluations et négociations. - Élaborer et exécuter des stratégies initiales de partenariat, y compris des stratégies d'embarquement et un positionnement concurrentiel pour les priorités. - Guider l'évaluation interfonctionnelle pour chaque opportunité, en coordonnant les évaluations scientifiques, cliniques, réglementaires et commerciales pour éclairer les décisions de gouvernance. - L'exécution des négociations : Collaborer étroitement avec le BD et les écosystèmes régionaux mène à faire progresser les possibilités hautement prioritaires par la négociation et la clôture du traité, en assurant le passage et l'exécution en douceur. - Représenter l'AT à l'extérieur, diriger les activités de recherche dans le cadre de conférences spécialisées et cultiver les relations avec la biotechnologie, l'enseignement universitaire et les communautés d'investissement.
• Exigences et expérience - Une participation importante en biotechnologie avec une expérience importante en innovation externe, en recherche et en évaluation ou en développement commercial. - Demande de diplôme de spécialiste (PhD, MD ou équivalent). - Il doit posséder une connaissance scientifique approfondie dans les domaines thérapeutiques de l'hématologie ou cardio-vasculaire/renal. - Provenance des expériences de leadership dans l'évaluation et la clôture des négociations initiales. - Un réseau solide au sein des organismes de biotechnologie, de formation universitaire et de BD pharmaceutique. Ce que nous offrons - Bureau/maison modèle de travail hybride. - Emplacement basé à Zurich (préféré) ou Maidenhead, Royaume-Uni, avec des voyages d'affaires importants. Personne à contacter Pour en savoir plus sur les avantages de CSL, visitez Comment CSL soutient votre bien-être. Désignation des marchandises CSL Behring est un leader mondial des produits biopharmaceutiques guidé par notre promesse de sauver des vies. Concentré sur les besoins des patients utilisant les dernières technologies, nous découvrons, développons et livrons des thérapies innovantes pour les personnes vivant avec des conditions dans les domaines thérapeutiques de l'immunologie, de l'hématologie, des maladies cardiovasculaires et métaboliques, des voies respiratoires et de la transplantation. Nous utilisons trois plateformes scientifiques stratégiques pour le fractionnement plasmatique, la technologie des protéines recombinantes et la thérapie cellulaire et génique pour soutenir l'innovation continue et affiner continuellement la façon dont les produits peuvent répondre aux besoins médicaux non satisfaits et aider les patients à mener une vie complète. CSL Behring exploite l'un des plus grands réseaux de collecte de plasma au monde, CSL Plasma. Notre société mère, CSL, basée à Melbourne, en Australie, emploie 32 000 personnes et livre ses thérapies vitales à des personnes dans plus de 100 pays. Pour de plus amples renseignements sur CSL, CSL Behring, CSL Seqirus et CSL Vifor, visitez https://www.csl.com/ et CSL Plasma à https://www.cslplasma.com/.

jobs.title: Senior Scientist, Technical Project Lead

titleByLocale.fr: Chercheur principal, responsable du projet technique

jobs.description:
Key Responsibilities

• Lead end-to-end technical projects across technology transfers, product lifecycle management, and continuous improvement initiatives for assigned products and external manufacturing partners.

• Develop and execute robust Project Execution Plans by translating technical implementation strategies into actionable project plans with clear milestones, timelines, resource requirements, and deliverables.

• Lead cross-functional project teams consisting of technical experts from multiple disciplines and external manufacturing partners to ensure successful project execution.

• Support project governance by proactively managing timelines, budgets, risks, issues, dependencies, KPIs, and project reporting.

• Prepare governance documentation, business cases, decision papers, and escalation packages to support timely and effective decision-making.

• Act as the primary technical interface towards Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CMOs) and external partners throughout project execution.

• Foster strong collaboration through proactive stakeholder engagement, effective communication, and alignment across internal functions and external partners.

• Support technical due diligence activities, manufacturing site assessments, and the evaluation of alternative manufacturing and sourcing strategies for APIs, drug products, starting materials, and raw materials.

• Provide on-site support at manufacturing facilities during key project phases to monitor progress, facilitate implementation, and resolve technical challenges.

Skills & Experience
Minimum Requirements

• Bachelor's or Master's degree (or equivalent) in Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Biotechnology, Pharmaceutical Sciences, or a related discipline.

• Demonstrated experience leading technical projects within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, chemical, or related industry.

• Experience in leading technology transfers, product/process transfers, lifecycle management, and/or continuous improvement initiatives.

• Strong project management capabilities with the ability to independently lead complex, cross-functional projects from initiation through completion.

• Self-driven, proactive, and able to take ownership in a dynamic environment.

• Excellent collaboration, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

• Experience working with external manufacturing organizations (CMOs/CDMOs).

• Willingness to travel internationally as required.
Preferred Requirements

• Solid understanding of GMP requirements and CMC lifecycle management

• Technical Background in CMC Development, Technical Transfer, Process Development, Manufacturing Science, or Commercial Manufacturing.

• Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities.

• Demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders and navigate complex matrix organizations.

• Experience working in an international, multicultural environment.

• Fluent in English; German is considered an advantage.

About CSL Vifor
CSL Vifor is a global partner of choice for pharmaceuticals and innovative, leading therapies in iron deficiency and nephrology. We specialize in strategic global partnering, in-licensing and developing, manufacturing and marketing pharmaceutical products for precision healthcare, aiming to help patients around the world lead better, healthier lives. Headquartered in St. Gallen, Switzerland, CSL Vifor also includes the joint company Vifor Fresenius Medical Care Renal Pharma (with Fresenius Medical Care). The parent company, CSL, headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, employs 32,000 people and delivers its lifesaving therapies to people in more than 100 countries.
To learn more about CSL, CSL Behring, CSL Seqirus and CSL Vifor visit https://www.csl.com/ and CSL Plasma at https://www.cslplasma.com/ .

Principali responsabilità

• Condurre progetti tecnici end-to-end attraverso trasferimenti tecnologici, gestione del ciclo di vita del prodotto e iniziative di miglioramento continuo per prodotti assegnati e partner di produzione esterni.

• Sviluppare ed eseguire robusti Piani di esecuzione del progetto traducendo strategie di implementazione tecnica in piani di progetto attuabili con chiare pietre miliari, linee temporali, requisiti di risorse e consegnabili.

• Leader team di progetto interfunzionali composto da esperti tecnici di più discipline e partner di produzione esterni per garantire l'esecuzione del progetto di successo.

• Sostenere la governance del progetto attraverso la gestione proattiva di termini, budget, rischi, questioni, dipendenze, KPI e report dei progetti.

• Preparare la documentazione di governance, i casi aziendali, i documenti decisionali e i pacchetti di escalation per sostenere il processo decisionale tempestivo ed efficace.

• Agire come interfaccia tecnica primaria verso le organizzazioni di produzione di contratti (CMO) e partner esterni durante l'esecuzione del progetto.

• Promuovere una forte collaborazione attraverso un coinvolgimento proattivo delle parti interessate, una comunicazione efficace e un allineamento tra funzioni interne e partner esterni.

• Supporta le attività di due diligence tecniche, le valutazioni dei siti di produzione e la valutazione di strategie alternative di produzione e approvvigionamento per API, prodotti farmaceutici, materie prime e materie prime.

• Fornire supporto in loco presso impianti di produzione durante le fasi chiave del progetto per monitorare i progressi, facilitare l'implementazione e risolvere le sfide tecniche.

Competenze e Esperienza
Requisiti minimi

• Corso di laurea o Master (o equivalente) in Scienze della vita, Farmacia, Chimica, Ingegneria chimica, Biotecnologia, Scienze farmaceutiche, o una disciplina relativa.

• Esperienza dimostrata che conduce progetti tecnici all'interno del settore farmaceutico, biotecnologico, chimico o relativo.

• Esperienza nei principali trasferimenti tecnologici, trasferimenti di prodotto/processo, gestione del ciclo di vita e/o iniziative di miglioramento continuo.

• Forte capacità di gestione del progetto con la capacità di condurre in modo indipendente progetti complessi e interfunzionali dall'iniziazione attraverso il completamento.

• Self-driven, proattivo, e in grado di prendere la proprietà in un ambiente dinamico.

• Ottima collaborazione, comunicazione e capacità di gestione degli stakeholder.

• Esperienza di lavoro con organizzazioni di produzione esterne (CMO/CDMO).

• Volontà di viaggiare a livello internazionale come richiesto.
Preferiti Requisiti

• Solida comprensione dei requisiti GMP e della gestione del ciclo di vita CMC

• Sfondo tecnico in CMC Sviluppo, Trasferimento Tecnico, Sviluppo di Processo, Scienza di Produzione o Produzione Commerciale.

• Forte pensiero analitico, problem solving e capacità decisionali.

• Dimostrata capacità di influenzare gli stakeholder e navigare organizzazioni di matrice complesse.

• Esperienza di lavoro in un ambiente internazionale e multiculturale.

• Fluente in inglese; il tedesco è considerato un vantaggio.

Informazioni su CSL Vifor
CSL Vifor è un partner globale di scelta per i prodotti farmaceutici e terapie innovative, leader nella carenza di ferro e nella nefrologia. Siamo specializzati nella partnership strategica globale, nell'licenziamento e nello sviluppo, nella produzione e nel marketing di prodotti farmaceutici per la salute di precisione, con l'obiettivo di aiutare i pazienti di tutto il mondo a condurre una vita migliore e più sana. Con sede a St. Gallen, Svizzera, CSL Vifor comprende anche la società comune Vifor Fresenius Medical Care Renal Pharma (con Fresenius Medical Care). La società madre, CSL, con sede a Melbourne, Australia, impiega 32.000 persone e fornisce le sue terapie salvavita alle persone in più di 100 paesi.
Per saperne di più su CSL, CSL Behring, CSL Seqirus e CSL Viper visita https://www.csl.com/ e CSL Plasma all'indirizzo https://www.cslplasma.com/ .

Wichtigste Zuständigkeiten

• Führen Sie durchgängige technische Projekte über Technologietransfers, Produktlebenszyklusmanagement und kontinuierliche Verbesserungsinitiativen für zugewiesene Produkte und externe Fertigungspartner.

• Entwickeln und ausführen Sie robuste Projektausführungspläne, indem Sie technische Umsetzungsstrategien in umsetzbare Projektpläne mit klaren Meilensteinen, Zeitplänen, Ressourcenanforderungen und Ergebnissen umsetzen.

• Führen Sie funktionsübergreifende Projektteams, bestehend aus technischen Experten aus verschiedenen Disziplinen und externen Fertigungspartnern, um eine erfolgreiche Projektdurchführung sicherzustellen.

• Unterstützen Sie die Projektsteuerung durch proaktives Management von Zeitplänen, Budgets, Risiken, Problemen, Abhängigkeiten, KPIs und Projektberichterstattung.

• Bereiten Sie Governance-Dokumentationen, Business Cases, Entscheidungspapiere und Eskalationspakete vor, um eine zeitnahe und effektive Entscheidungsfindung zu unterstützen.

• Handeln Sie als primäre technische Schnittstelle zu Contract Manufacturing Organizations (CMOs) und externen Partnern während der gesamten Projektdurchführung.

• Förderung einer starken Zusammenarbeit durch proaktives Stakeholder-Engagement, effektive Kommunikation und Ausrichtung auf interne Funktionen und externe Partner.

• Unterstützen Sie technische Due-Diligence-Aktivitäten, Produktionsstandortbewertungen und die Bewertung alternativer Herstellungs- und Beschaffungsstrategien für APIs, Arzneimittel, Ausgangsmaterialien und Rohstoffe.

• Bereitstellung von Vor-Ort-Unterstützung in Produktionsstätten während wichtiger Projektphasen, um den Fortschritt zu überwachen, die Umsetzung zu erleichtern und technische Herausforderungen zu lösen.

Fähigkeiten und Erfahrungen
Mindestanforderungen

• Bachelor- oder Master-Abschluss (oder gleichwertig) in Life Sciences, Pharmazie, Chemie, Chemieingenieurwesen, Biotechnologie, Pharmazeutische Wissenschaften oder einer verwandten Disziplin.

• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung bei der Leitung technischer Projekte in der pharmazeutischen, biotechnologischen, chemischen oder verwandten Industrie.

jobs.title: Product Strategy Lead

titleByLocale.fr: Responsable de la stratégie des produits

jobs.description:
The Opportunity:
The Product Strategy Lead is the end‑to‑end owner of integrated Product Strategy for an assigned portfolio of products, accountable for translating commercial ambition and R&D strategy into clear, executable manufacturing and operations strategies across the full product lifecycle.

This role serves as the primary strategic integrator across Manufacturing and Technical Operations, Commercial, R&D, Business Development, Quality, Regulatory, Supply Chain, Finance, and Network Strategy. The Product Strategy Lead ensures product‑level decisions regarding investment, capacity, capability, and lifecycle trade‑offs are coherent, value‑driven, and aligned to enterprise priorities, enabling safe, reliable supply of CSL products to patients.

Acting as the product’s representative in senior governance forums, the Product Strategy Lead shapes and anchors product‑level strategic decisions, ensuring leadership has a clear, fact‑based view of options, risks, trade‑offs, and value implications across time horizons.

The Role:
Product Strategy Ownership and Integration

• Owns the single, integrated Product Strategy for assigned products, ensuring end‑to‑end alignment across Commercial, R&D, BD, and Operations.

• Acts as the product‑level strategy decision owner within Operations, accountable for framing options, recommending trade‑offs, and anchoring decisions adopted through governance.

• Ensures product strategies balance cost, risk, speed, supply resilience, and long‑term enterprise value.

Portfolio & Lifecycle Strategy

• Leads end‑to‑end product lifecycle strategy, including development, launch strategy, growth, optimization, and end‑of‑life decisions.

• Actively manages portfolio trade‑offs across assigned products, including prioritization, sequencing of investments, and capacity or capability allocation.

• Ensures lifecycle decisions are grounded in both current performance and future portfolio needs.

Financial & Investment Framing

• Owns the financial and value framing of product‑level strategy decisions, including investment rationale, scenario analysis, and long‑term value impact.

• Provides product inputs into Long‑Range Planning (LRP), ensuring commercial assumptions, manufacturing strategy, and capacity plans are tightly aligned.

• Partners with Finance to ensure leadership decisions are supported by clear economic logic and value realization expectations.

Cross Functional Alignment and Orchestration

• Leads and orchestrates cross‑functional stakeholders across TechOps, Network Strategy, R&D, Commercial, Supply Chain, Quality, Regulatory, Finance, Procurement, and BD.

• Drives alignment and resolves conflicts across competing priorities, operating effectively without direct authority.

• Ensures execution ownership and decision rights are clear following governance outcomes.

Executive Governance & Communication

• Develops and presents decision‑ready recommendations to senior governance bodies including GLT members, NRB, ORB, IBP, and other executive forums.

• Distills complex technical, regulatory, manufacturing, and financial information into clear executive narratives.

• Acts as a trusted strategic advisor to senior leaders on product‑level strategy matters.

Product Lifecycle and Portfolio Strategy

• Leads end‑to‑end product lifecycle management, including development, launch, growth, optimization, and end‑of‑life decisions.

• Ensures portfolio strategy balances near‑term performance with long‑term enterprise value creation.

Owns product‑level inputs into Long‑Range Planning (LRP)

• Converts commercial forecasts, Business Development intent, and lifecycle scenarios into clear demand, volume, timing, and risk assumptions

• Ensures assumptions are internally consistent and defensible across functions

• Acts as the single source of truth for product demand logic in planning cycles

• Integrates LRP and capacity decisions into product lifecycle strategy

• Shapes capacity and network strate

L'opportunità:
The Product Strategy Lead è il proprietario end-to-end di Product Strategy integrato per un portafoglio assegnato di prodotti, responsabile per la traduzione dell'ambizione commerciale e della strategia R&D in chiare ed esecutive strategie di produzione e di gestione in tutto il ciclo di vita del prodotto.

Questo ruolo funge da integratore strategico primario per le operazioni di produzione e tecnica, commerciale, R&D, sviluppo aziendale, qualità, regolamentazione, supply chain, finanza e strategia di rete. La strategia di prodotto Lead assicura decisioni a livello di prodotto per quanto riguarda gli investimenti, la capacità, la capacità e i trade-off del ciclo di vita sono coerenti, orientati al valore e allineati alle priorità aziendali, consentendo la fornitura sicura e affidabile dei prodotti CSL ai pazienti.

In qualità di rappresentante del prodotto nei forum di governance senior, la strategia del prodotto Piombo forme e ancora le decisioni strategiche a livello di prodotto, assicurando la leadership ha una visione chiara, basata sul fatto di opzioni, rischi, trade-off e implicazioni di valore attraverso orizzonti di tempo.

Il ruolo:
ProprietÃ e integrazione della strategia di prodotto

• Possiede la strategia di prodotto integrata per i prodotti assegnati, garantendo l'allineamento end-to-end attraverso Commercial, R&D, BD e Operations.

• Agisce come il proprietario della decisione di strategia di livello del prodotto all'interno delle Operazioni, responsabile per le opzioni di inquadramento, raccomandando i trade-off e ancorando le decisioni adottate attraverso la governance.

• Assicura le strategie di prodotto il costo di bilanciamento, il rischio, la velocità, la resilienza di approvvigionamento e il valore aziendale a lungo termine.

Portfolio & Lifecycle Strategy

• Conduce la strategia end-to-end del ciclo di vita del prodotto, tra cui sviluppo, strategia di lancio, crescita, ottimizzazione e decisioni end-of-life.

• Gestisce attivamente i trade-off di portafoglio tra i prodotti assegnati, tra cui priorità, sequenziamento degli investimenti, e allocazione di capacità o capacità.

• Garantisce che le decisioni del ciclo di vita siano fondate sia sulle attuali prestazioni che sulle future esigenze del portafoglio.

Finanziamenti e investimenti

• Possiede l'inquadratura finanziaria e di valore delle decisioni di strategia a livello di prodotto, tra cui la razionalità degli investimenti, l'analisi degli scenari e l'impatto del valore a lungo termine.

• Fornisce input di prodotto in Long-Range Planning (LRP), assicurando presupposti commerciali, strategia di produzione e piani di capacità sono strettamente allineati.

• I partner con Finance per garantire decisioni di leadership sono sostenuti da chiare aspettative di logica economica e di realizzazione del valore.

allineamento funzionale trasversale e orchestrazione

• Conduce e orchestra le parti interessate interfunzionali attraverso TechOps, Network Strategy, R&D, Commercial, Supply Chain, Qualità, Regolazione, Finanza, Procurement e BD.

• Guida l'allineamento e risolve i conflitti tra le priorità concorrenti, operando efficacemente senza autorità diretta.

• Assicura la proprietà dell'esecuzione e i diritti di decisione sono chiari dopo i risultati della governance.

Governance e comunicazione

• Sviluppa e presenta raccomandazioni per gli enti di governance senior, tra cui membri del GLT, NRB, ORB, IBP e altri forum executive.

• Distilla complesse informazioni tecniche, regolamentari, produttive e finanziarie in chiare narrazioni esecutive.

• Agisce come consulente strategico di fiducia per i leader senior in materia di strategia a livello di prodotto.

Lifecycle and Portfolio Strategy

• Conduce la gestione end-to-end del ciclo di vita del prodotto, tra cui le decisioni di sviluppo, lancio, crescita, ottimizzazione e end-of-life.

• Garantisce il bilanciamento della strategia del portafoglio delle prestazioni a breve termine con la creazione di valore aziendale a lungo termine.

Possiede input a livello di prodotto nella pianificazione a lungo raggio (LRP)

• Converte previsioni commerciali, intenti di sviluppo aziendale e scenari del ciclo di vita in chiara domanda, volume, tempistica e presupposti di rischio

• Assicura i presupposti sono internamente coerenti e defensibili attraverso le funzioni

• Agisce come unica fonte di verità per la logica della domanda di prodotto nei cicli di pianificazione

• Integra LRP e le decisioni di capacità nella strategia del ciclo di vita del prodotto

• Forma capacità e rete strate

descriptionByLocale.de:
Die Gelegenheit:
Der Product Strategy Lead ist der End-to-End-Eigentümer der integrierten Produktstrategie für ein zugewiesenes Produktportfolio, das dafür verantwortlich ist, kommerzielle Ambitionen und F & E-Strategie in klare, ausführbare Fertigungs- und Betriebsstrategien über den gesamten Produktlebenszyklus zu übersetzen.

Diese Rolle dient als primärer strategischer Integrator in den Bereichen Fertigung und technische Operationen, Kommerzielle Entwicklung, F & E, Geschäftsentwicklung, Qualität, Regulierung, Supply Chain, Finanzen und Netzwerkstrategie. Der Product Strategy Lead stellt sicher, dass Entscheidungen auf Produktebene in Bezug auf Investitionen, Kapazität, Kapazität und Lebenszyklus-Kompromisse kohärent, wertorientiert und an den Unternehmensprioritäten ausgerichtet sind, was eine sichere und zuverlässige Versorgung der Patienten mit CSL-Produkten ermöglicht.

Als Vertreter des Produkts in Senior-Governance-Foren gestaltet und verankert der Product Strategy Lead strategische Entscheidungen auf Produktebene und stellt sicher, dass die Führung eine klare, faktenbasierte Sicht auf Optionen, Risiken, Kompromisse und Wertimplikationen über Zeithorizonte hinweg hat.

Die Rolle:
Product Strategy Ownership und Integration

• Eigentümer der einzigen, integrierten Produktstrategie für zugewiesene Produkte, die eine End-to-End-Anpassung in den Bereichen Commercial, R&D, BD und Operations gewährleistet.

• Agiert als Eigentümer der Strategieentscheidung auf Produktebene innerhalb von Operations, verantwortlich für die Gestaltung von Optionen, die Empfehlung von Kompromissen und die Verankerung von Entscheidungen, die durch Governance getroffen werden.

• Sicherstellt, dass Produktstrategien Kosten, Risiko, Geschwindigkeit, Versorgungsresistenz und langfristigen Unternehmenswert ausgleichen.

Portfolio & Lifecycle Strategie

• Leitet eine End-to-End-Produktlebenszyklusstrategie, einschließlich Entwicklung, Launch-Strategie, Wachstum, Optimierung und End-of-Life-Entscheidungen.

• Verwaltet aktiv Portfolio-Trade-offs über zugewiesene Produkte hinweg, einschließlich Priorisierung, Sequenzierung von Investitionen und Kapazitäts- oder Kapazitätszuweisung.

• Stellen Sie sicher, dass Lifecycle-Entscheidungen sowohl auf der aktuellen Performance als auch auf den zukünftigen Portfolioanforderungen basieren.

Financial & Investment Framing

• Besitzt die Finanz- und Wertgestaltung von Strategieentscheidungen auf Produktebene, einschließlich Anlagegrundsätzen, Szenarioanalysen und langfristigen Wertwirkungen.

• Bietet Produktinputs in die Langstreckenplanung (LRP), um sicherzustellen, dass kommerzielle Annahmen, Fertigungsstrategie und Kapazitätspläne eng aufeinander abgestimmt sind.

• Partner mit Finance, um sicherzustellen, dass Führungsentscheidungen durch klare wirtschaftliche Logik und Wertrealisierungserwartungen unterstützt werden.

Cross Functional Alignment und Orchestrierung

• Leitet und orchestriert funktionsübergreifende Stakeholder in den Bereichen TechOps, Network Strategy, R&D, Commercial, Supply Chain, Quality, Regulatory, Finance, Procurement und BD.

• Fördert die Ausrichtung und löst Konflikte über konkurrierende Prioritäten hinweg und arbeitet effektiv ohne direkte Autorität.

• Stellt sicher, dass Ausführungseigentum und Entscheidungsrechte nach den Governance-Ergebnissen klar sind.

Executive Governance und Kommunikation

• Entwickelt und präsentiert entscheidungsbereite Empfehlungen an leitende Führungsgremien, darunter GLT-Mitglieder, NRB, ORB, IBP und andere Exekutivforen.

• Destilliert komplexe technische, regulatorische, Fertigungs- und Finanzinformationen in klare Executive Narrative.

• Sie fungiert als vertrauenswürdiger strategischer Berater für Führungskräfte in Fragen der Produktstrategie.

Product Lifecycle und Portfoliostrategie

• Leitet End-to-End-Produktlebenszyklusmanagement, einschließlich Entwicklung, Einführung, Wachstum, Optimierung und End-of-Life-Entscheidungen.

• Sicherstellt, dass die Portfoliostrategie die kurzfristige Performance mit der langfristigen Wertschöpfung von Unternehmen in Einklang bringt.

Eigene Inputs auf Produktebene in Long-Range Planning (LRP)

• Konvertiert kommerzielle Prognosen, Geschäftsentwicklungsabsichten und Lebenszyklusszenarien in klare Nachfrage-, Volumen-, Timing- und Risikoannahmen

• Stellen Sie sicher, dass Annahmen intern konsistent und funktionsübergreifend vertretbar sind

• Agiert als Single Source of Truth für Produktnachfragelogik in Planungszyklen

• Integration von LRP- und Kapazitätsentscheidungen in die Product Lifecycle-Strategie

• Formt Kapazität und Netzwerk-Strate
descriptionByLocale.fr:
La possibilité :
Le responsable de la stratégie des produits est le propriétaire de bout en bout de la stratégie intégrée des produits pour un portefeuille de produits assigné, responsable de la traduction de l'ambition commerciale et de la stratégie de R-D en stratégies de fabrication et d'exploitation claires et exécutables tout au long du cycle de vie des produits.

Ce rôle est le principal intégrateur stratégique dans les secteurs de la fabrication et des opérations techniques, du commerce, de la R-D, du développement des entreprises, de la qualité, de la réglementation, de la chaîne d'approvisionnement, des finances et de la stratégie de réseau. Le responsable de la stratégie des produits veille à ce que les décisions relatives à l'investissement, à la capacité, à la capacité et au cycle de vie soient cohérentes, axées sur la valeur et alignées sur les priorités de l'entreprise, ce qui permet un approvisionnement sûr et fiable des patients en produits LSC.

En tant que représentant du produit dans les forums de gouvernance de haut niveau, la Stratégie produit Le chef de file façonne et ancre les décisions stratégiques au niveau du produit, en s'assurant que le leadership a une vision claire et factuelle des options, des risques, des compromis et des répercussions sur la valeur à travers les horizons temporels.

Le rôle :
Stratégie de produit Propriété et intégration

• Posséder la stratégie unique et intégrée des produits attribués, en assurant l'harmonisation de bout en bout entre les activités commerciales, de R-D, de BD et d'exploitation.

• Agit en tant que propriétaire de décision au niveau des produits au sein des Opérations, responsable de l'élaboration des options, de la recommandation des compromis et de l'ancrage des décisions adoptées par la gouvernance.

• S'assure que les stratégies de produits équilibrent les coûts, les risques, la vitesse, la résilience de l'offre et la valeur à long terme de l'entreprise.

Stratégie du Portefeuille et du cycle de vie

• Dirige la stratégie du cycle de vie des produits de bout en bout, y compris le développement, la stratégie de lancement, la croissance, l'optimisation et les décisions de fin de vie.

• Gérer activement les arbitrages de portefeuille entre les produits attribués, y compris la hiérarchisation, le séquençage des investissements et l'attribution des capacités.

• S'assure que les décisions relatives au cycle de vie sont fondées à la fois sur la performance actuelle et sur les besoins futurs du portefeuille.

Cadre financier et d'investissement

• Possède l'encadrement financier et de valeur des décisions stratégiques au niveau des produits, y compris la justification de l'investissement, l'analyse de scénarios et l'impact à long terme sur la valeur.

• Fournit des intrants de produits dans la planification à long terme (PDR), en veillant à ce que les hypothèses commerciales, la stratégie de fabrication et les plans de capacité soient étroitement alignés.

• Les partenaires du ministère des Finances s'assurent que les décisions en matière de leadership sont étayées par une logique économique claire et des attentes en matière de valorisation.

Alignement et orchestre fonctionnels croisés

• Dirige et orchestre les intervenants interfonctionnels dans l'ensemble de TechOps, Stratégie de réseau, R-D, Commercial, Chaîne d'approvisionnement, Qualité, Réglementation, Finances, Approvisionnement et BD.

• Conduit l'alignement et règle les conflits entre les priorités concurrentes, fonctionnant efficacement sans autorité directe.

• Veiller à ce que les droits de propriété et de décision soient clairs à la suite des résultats de la gouvernance.

Gouvernance exécutive et communication

• Élaborer et présenter des recommandations prêtes à prendre des décisions à l'intention des organismes supérieurs de gouvernance, y compris les membres du GLT, le CRN, le BPR, le BPI et d'autres forums de la direction.

• Distiller des informations techniques, réglementaires, manufacturières et financières complexes dans des récits clairs de l'exécutif.

• Agir à titre de conseiller stratégique de confiance auprès des cadres supérieurs sur les questions de stratégie au niveau des produits.

Cycle de vie des produits et stratégie de portefeuille

• Diriger la gestion du cycle de vie des produits de bout en bout, y compris les décisions de développement, de lancement, de croissance, d'optimisation et de fin de vie.

• Assurer des équilibres stratégiques à court terme avec la création de valeur à long terme de l'entreprise.

Possède des intrants de niveau produit dans la planification à long terme (PLT)

• Convertit les prévisions commerciales, l'intention de développement des entreprises et les scénarios du cycle de vie en une demande claire, en volume, en calendrier et en hypothèses de risque

Gestione delle modifiche & Stakeholder Engagement

• Servire come partner di pensiero strategico per la leadership senior, fornendo informazioni su abilitazione digitale, creazione di valore e tendenze emergenti.

• Collabora con partner interni ed esterni per garantire un'integrazione senza soluzione di continuità delle soluzioni digitali e l'allineamento con le esigenze aziendali.

Governance e conformità:

• Sostenere i processi di governance e decision-making preparando contenuti a livello esecutivo, facilitando le riunioni e implementando efficacemente gli elementi di azione.

Miglioramento continuo e innovazione:

• Guidare iniziative di miglioramento continuo, sfruttando strumenti digitali e metodologie (Agile, Lean, Six Sigma) per ottimizzare le prestazioni di produzione.

• Monitorare le tendenze del settore e le attività concorrenti per informare e adattare le strategie digitali.

Competenze ed Esperienza:

• 8+ anni di esperienza progressiva che conduce iniziative di trasformazione digitale all'interno di scienze della vita, biofarmaci, produzione o altre industrie altamente regolamentate.

• Comprensione profonda della produzione digitale, del processo decisionale, dell'automazione, dell'analisi avanzata, dell'intelligenza artificiale/ML e delle piattaforme basate su cloud.

• Capacità comprovata di identificare, prioritizzare e implementare miglioramenti di business abilitati alla tecnologia attraverso funzioni, tra cui operazioni, qualità, supply chain, R&D o organizzazioni commerciali.

• Forte track record dei principali team interfunzionali, influenzando gli stakeholder senior, e guidando l'adozione di nuove capacità digitali attraverso efficaci strategie di gestione dei cambiamenti e di comunicazione.

• Competenze eccezionali per il programma e la gestione dei progetti, con esperienza che supervisiona iniziative di trasformazione su larga scala dallo sviluppo della strategia attraverso l'esecuzione e la realizzazione del valore.

• Der Digital Strategy Lead ist verantwortlich für die Arbeit über operative Funktionen hinweg, um die digitale Transformations-Roadmap für Operationen zu entwickeln und die Ausführung zu erleichtern.

• Die Position ist eine Partnerschaft mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams, um sicherzustellen, dass digitale Initiativen an den Geschäftszielen und regulatorischen Anforderungen ausgerichtet sind und messbaren Wert im gesamten Fertigungsnetzwerk liefern.

Die Rolle:
Strategische Führung & Vision:

• Definieren und implementieren Sie die digitale Strategie für den Betrieb und gewährleisten Sie die Ausrichtung auf die Unternehmensziele und Best Practices der Branche.

• Entwicklung und Pflege einer umfassenden Roadmap für die digitale Transformation, einschließlich KI, Automatisierung, Datenanalyse und Industrie 4.0-Initiativen.

• Setzen Sie sich für die Integration digitaler Technologien ein, um Workflows zu optimieren, die Datenintegrität zu verbessern und Entscheidungen in Echtzeit zu ermöglichen.

• Bewerten und implementieren Sie neue Technologien (AI / ML, digitale Zwillinge, Cloud Computing, IoT), um Innovationen und operative Exzellenz voranzutreiben.

Data & Analytics:

• Nutzen Sie Advanced Analytics und Machine Learning, um umsetzbare Erkenntnisse zu generieren, Prozesse zu optimieren und proaktive Entscheidungen zu treffen.

• Förderung der Entwicklung von digitalen Dashboards, KPIs und Reporting-Tools zur Überwachung von Leistung und Wertschöpfung.

Change Management & Stakeholder Engagement

• Förderung von Bewusstsein, Adoption und Change Management für digitale Initiativen und Förderung einer Digital-First-Kultur in allen Geschäftsbereichen.

• Dienen Sie als strategischer Denkpartner für Führungskräfte und bieten Sie Einblicke in die digitale Enablement, Wertschöpfung und neue Trends.

• Arbeiten Sie mit internen und externen Partnern zusammen, um eine nahtlose Integration digitaler Lösungen und die Ausrichtung auf die Geschäftsanforderungen zu gewährleisten.

Governance & Compliance:

• Unterstützung von Governance- und Entscheidungsprozessen durch die Vorbereitung von Inhalten auf Führungsebene, die Erleichterung von Meetings und die effektive Umsetzung von Maßnahmen.

Kontinuierliche Verbesserung & Innovation:

• Führen Sie kontinuierliche Verbesserungsinitiativen durch die Nutzung digitaler Tools und Methoden (Agile, Lean, Six Sigma) zur Optimierung der Fertigungsleistung.

• Überwachen Sie Branchentrends und Wettbewerbsaktivitäten, um digitale Strategien zu informieren und anzupassen.

Fähigkeiten und Erfahrung:

• Bachelor- oder Master-Abschluss in Ingenieurwissenschaften, Informatik, Data Science, Business oder einem verwandten Bereich.

• 8+ Jahre fortschrittliche Erfahrung in der Leitung digitaler Transformationsinitiativen in den Bereichen Biowissenschaften, Biopharma, Fertigung oder anderen stark regulierten Branchen.

• Nachgewiesener Erfolg bei der Entwicklung und Durchführung unternehmensweiter digitaler Transformationsstrategien, die den Geschäftswert, die operative Exzellenz und den organisatorischen Wandel in komplexen, matrixförmigen Umgebungen vorantreiben.

• Tiefes Verständnis für digitale Fertigung, datengesteuerte Entscheidungsfindung, Automatisierung, Advanced Analytics, AI / ML und Cloud-basierte Plattformen.

• Starke Erfolgsbilanz bei führenden funktionsübergreifenden Teams, bei der Beeinflussung leitender Stakeholder und bei der Einführung neuer digitaler Fähigkeiten durch effektive Change Management- und Kommunikationsstrategien.

• Le poste s'associe à des équipes interfonctionnelles afin de s'assurer que les initiatives numériques sont conformes aux objectifs opérationnels et aux exigences réglementaires et offrent une valeur mesurable dans l'ensemble du réseau de fabrication.

• Ce rôle est étroitement lié aux activités d'I et T de son partenaire opérationnel afin d'assurer l'harmonisation des objectifs et de la gouvernance.

Leadership stratégique et vision :

• Définir et exécuter la stratégie numérique pour les opérations, en assurant l'alignement avec les objectifs de l'entreprise et les meilleures pratiques de l'industrie.

• Élaborer et tenir à jour une feuille de route complète pour la transformation numérique, y compris l'IA, l'automatisation, l'analyse des données et les initiatives de l'industrie 4.0.

• Diriger les équipes interfonctionnelles pour mettre en œuvre et à l'échelle des initiatives numériques, en assurant une mise en œuvre et une adoption réussies dans les sites de fabrication mondiaux.

Opérations numériques et déploiement de la technologie :

• Promouvoir l'intégration des technologies numériques pour rationaliser les flux de travail, améliorer l'intégrité des données et permettre la prise de décisions en temps réel.

• Évaluer et mettre en œuvre les technologies émergentes (AI/ML, jumelles numériques, cloud computing, IoT) pour stimuler l'innovation et l'excellence opérationnelle.

Données et analyses :

• Servir de partenaire de réflexion stratégique pour les cadres supérieurs, fournissant des renseignements sur l'habilitation numérique, la création de valeur et les tendances émergentes.

• Collaborer avec des partenaires internes et externes pour assurer une intégration transparente des solutions numériques et l'alignement avec les besoins des entreprises.

Amélioration continue et innovation :

• Surveiller les tendances de l'industrie et les activités des concurrents afin d'informer et d'adapter les stratégies numériques.

jobs.description:
For our global Technical Operations Organization, we are currently looking for a

Analytical Testing Lead / Principal Scientist (m/f/x )

Fullltime / Permanent / Closing date April 17th
Locations available: Bern

The Opportunity
This role drives the discovery and development of innovative medicines that address unmet medical needs, guiding projects from early research through clinical trials and toward global commercialization. It ensures the highest standards of clinical safety while managing advanced research analyses, information systems, and technical documentation. The position also supports laboratory activities and helps maintain regulatory approvals by collaborating closely with health authorities. Additionally, it provides expert scientific guidance, implements specialized technical capabilities, and contributes to rigorous experiment planning, execution, and reporting. The role further supports the growth of the R&D organization by training team members in key scientific and technological platforms.

Key Responsibilities:

• Leads the design, implementation, and optimization of advanced technical capabilities, guiding cross-functional teams to achieve complex research objectives within defined timelines

• Oversees the planning, execution, and interpretation of high-impact scientific experiments, ensuring the highest standards of scientific rigor and integrity

• Mentors and develops scientific staff, fostering technical growth and knowledge transfer across the organization

• Serves as a recognized authority in the field, contributing to scientific strategy, portfolio planning, and external collaborations

• Manages large-scale, cross-functional projects or programs with minimal oversight, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and regulatory expectations

• Solves complex, multi-dimensional problems requiring deep technical insight and cross-disciplinary collaboration

• Represents the organization in scientific forums, publications, and external partnerships, enhancing visibility and thought leadership

Your skills and experience

• PhD in a scientific discipline

• Typically, 5–8 years of related experience

• Track record of scientific achievement in relevant Life Sciences discipline

• Mastery of advanced methodologies

• Oversight of research cross-functional teams and initiatives

• Setting direction for scientific programs

• Excellent communication skills (English language).

CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients’ needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas. We use three strategic scientific platforms of plasma fractionation, recombinant protein technology, and cell and gene therapy to support continued innovation and continually refine ways in which products can address unmet medical needs and help patients lead full lives.

CSL Behring operates one of the world’s largest plasma collection networks, CSL Plasma. Our parent company, CSL, headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, employs 32,000 people, and delivers its lifesaving therapies to people in more than 100 countries.

descriptionByLocale.en:
For our global Technical Operations Organization, we are currently looking for a

Analytical Testing Lead / Principal Scientist (m/f/x )

Fullltime / Permanent / Closing date April 17th
Locations available: Bern

The Opportunity
This role drives the discovery and development of innovative medicines that address unmet medical needs, guiding projects from early research through clinical trials and toward global commercialization. It ensures the highest standards of clinical safety while managing advanced research analyses, information systems, and technical documentation. The position also supports laboratory activities and helps maintain regulatory approvals by collaborating closely with health authorities. Additionally, it provides expert scientific guidance, implements specialized technical capabilities, and contributes to rigorous experiment planning, execution, and reporting. The role further supports the growth of the R&D organization by training team members in key scientific and technological platforms.

Key Responsibilities:

• Leads the design, implementation, and optimization of advanced technical capabilities, guiding cross-functional teams to achieve complex research objectives within defined timelines

• Oversees the planning, execution, and interpretation of high-impact scientific experiments, ensuring the highest standards of scientific rigor and integrity

• Mentors and develops scientific staff, fostering technical growth and knowledge transfer across the organization

• Serves as a recognized authority in the field, contributing to scientific strategy, portfolio planning, and external collaborations

• Manages large-scale, cross-functional projects or programs with minimal oversight, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and regulatory expectations

• Solves complex, multi-dimensional problems requiring deep technical insight and cross-disciplinary collaboration

• Represents the organization in scientific forums, publications, and external partnerships, enhancing visibility and thought leadership

Your skills and experience

• PhD in a scientific discipline

• Typically, 5–8 years of related experience

• Track record of scientific achievement in relevant Life Sciences discipline

• Mastery of advanced methodologies

• Oversight of research cross-functional teams and initiatives

• Setting direction for scientific programs

• Excellent communication skills (English language).

About CSL Behring
CSL Behring is a global biotherapeutics leader driven by our promise to save lives. Focused on serving patients’ needs by using the latest technologies, we discover, develop and deliver innovative therapies for people living with conditions in the immunology, hematology, cardiovascular and metabolic, respiratory, and transplant therapeutic areas. We use three strategic scientific platforms of plasma fractionation, recombinant protein technology, and cell and gene therapy to support continued innovation and continually refine ways in which products can address unmet medical needs and help patients lead full lives.

CSL Behring operates one of the world’s largest plasma collection networks, CSL Plasma. Our parent company, CSL, headquartered in Melbourne, Australia, employs 32,000 people, and delivers its lifesaving therapies to people in more than 100 countries.
To learn more about CSL, CSL Behring, CSL Seqirus and CSL Vifor visit https://www.csl.com/ and CSL Plasma at https://www.cslplasma.com/ .

Our Benefits
For more information on CSL benefits visit How CSL Supports Your Well-being | CSL .

You Belong at CSL
At CSL, Inclusion and Belonging is at the core of our mission and who we are. It fuels our innovation day in and day out. By celebrating our differences and creating a culture of curiosity and empathy, we are able to better understand and connect with our patients and donors, foster strong relationships with our stakeholders, and sustain a diverse workforce that will move our company and industry into the
descriptionByLocale.de:

Leitende analytische Prüfung / Hauptwissenschaftler (m/w/x )

Standorte verfügbar: Bern

Die Chance
Diese Rolle treibt die Entdeckung und Entwicklung innovativer Medikamente an, die auf unerfüllte medizinische Bedürfnisse eingehen und Projekte von der frühen Forschung über klinische Studien bis hin zur globalen Kommerzialisierung leiten. Es gewährleistet die höchsten Standards der klinischen Sicherheit und verwaltet fortschrittliche Forschungsanalysen, Informationssysteme und technische Dokumentation. Die Position unterstützt auch die Laboraktivitäten und hilft bei der Aufrechterhaltung der behördlichen Zulassungen durch die enge Zusammenarbeit mit Gesundheitsbehörden. Darüber hinaus bietet es fachkundige wissenschaftliche Beratung, implementiert spezialisierte technische Fähigkeiten und trägt zu einer rigorosen Planung, Durchführung und Berichterstattung von Experimenten bei. Die Rolle unterstützt das Wachstum der F & E-Organisation durch die Schulung von Teammitgliedern in wichtigen wissenschaftlichen und technologischen Plattformen.

Hauptzuständigkeiten:

• Leitet die Gestaltung, Implementierung und Optimierung fortschrittlicher technischer Fähigkeiten und leitet funktionsübergreifende Teams, um komplexe Forschungsziele innerhalb definierter Zeitlinien zu erreichen

• Beaufsichtigt die Planung, Durchführung und Interpretation von einflussreichen wissenschaftlichen Experimenten und gewährleistet die höchsten Standards wissenschaftlicher Strenge und Integrität

• Mentoren und entwickelt wissenschaftliche Mitarbeiter, fördert technisches Wachstum und Wissenstransfer in der gesamten Organisation

• Er dient als anerkannte Autorität auf diesem Gebiet und trägt zur wissenschaftlichen Strategie, Portfolioplanung und externen Kooperationen bei.

• Verwaltet groß angelegte, funktionsübergreifende Projekte oder Programme mit minimaler Aufsicht, um die Übereinstimmung mit organisatorischen Zielen und regulatorischen Erwartungen sicherzustellen

• Löst komplexe, multidimensionale Probleme, die einen tiefen technischen Einblick und eine interdisziplinäre Zusammenarbeit erfordern

• Repräsentiert die Organisation in wissenschaftlichen Foren, Publikationen und externen Partnerschaften, verbessert die Sichtbarkeit und Vordenkerrolle

Ihre Fähigkeiten und Erfahrungen

• PhD in einer wissenschaftlichen Disziplin

• Typischerweise 5-8 Jahre verwandte Erfahrung

• Erfolgreiche wissenschaftliche Leistungen in der relevanten Life Sciences Disziplin

• Beherrschung fortgeschrittener Methoden

• Aufsicht über funktionsübergreifende Forschungsteams und -initiativen

• Richtung für wissenschaftliche Programme

• Hervorragende Kommunikationsfähigkeiten (englische Sprache).

Über CSL Behring
CSL Behring ist ein weltweit führender Anbieter von Biotherapeutika, angetrieben von unserem Versprechen, Leben zu retten. Konzentriert auf die Bedürfnisse der Patienten durch den Einsatz der neuesten Technologien, entdecken, entwickeln und liefern wir innovative Therapien für Menschen mit Erkrankungen in den Bereichen Immunologie, Hämatologie, Herz-Kreislauf und Stoffwechsel, Atmung und Transplantation. Wir nutzen drei strategische wissenschaftliche Plattformen der Plasmafraktionierung, rekombinante Proteintechnologie und Zell- und Gentherapie, um kontinuierliche Innovationen zu unterstützen und kontinuierlich Wege zu verfeinern, wie Produkte ungedeckte medizinische Bedürfnisse erfüllen und Patienten helfen können, ein volles Leben zu führen.

CSL Behring betreibt eines der weltweit größten Plasmasammelnetze, CSL Plasma. Unsere Muttergesellschaft CSL mit Hauptsitz in Melbourne, Australien, beschäftigt 32.000 Mitarbeiter und liefert ihre lebensrettenden Therapien an Menschen in mehr als 100 Ländern.
Mehr über CSL, CSL Behring, CSL Seqirus und CSL Vifor erfahren Sie unter https://www.csl.com/ und CSL Plasma unter https://www.cslplasma.com/ .

Unsere Vorteile
Weitere Informationen zu den CSL-Vorteilen finden Sie unter Wie CSL Ihr Wohlbefinden unterstützt | CSL .

Sie gehören zu CSL
Bei CSL steht Inklusion und Zugehörigkeit im Mittelpunkt unserer Mission und wer wir sind. Es treibt unsere Innovation Tag für Tag an. Indem wir unsere Unterschiede feiern und eine Kultur der Neugier und Empathie schaffen, sind wir in der Lage, unsere Patienten und Spender besser zu verstehen und uns mit ihnen zu verbinden, starke Beziehungen zu unseren Stakeholdern zu pflegen und eine vielfältige Belegschaft zu erhalten, die unser Unternehmen und unsere Branche in die Welt bringen wird.

Pour notre Organisation mondiale des opérations techniques,

Tests analytiques Responsable / Chercheur principal (m/f/x )

Temps plein / Permanent / Date de clôture 17 avril
